title: Human Resources Intern
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Human Resources Intern em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you a student pursuing a degree in Business, Human Resources, or a related field—with a passion for people, processes, and efficiency? Join our dynamic Talent Acquisition team as an intern and gain hands-on experience in HR Systems and Onboarding. This internship offers a unique entry point into the world of Human Resources and Talent Acquisition. You’ll build essential skills in Global new hire onboarding and HR systems and will gain practical experience and grow professionally in a supportive, collaborative environment.


Whether you're considering a future in HR, business administration, or both, this role offers the perfect blend of strategy, creativity, and people-focused work.


Why Join InComm?

  • Paid Internship
  • 30-hour workweek with a flexible Monday–Friday schedule
  • Real-world experience with a leading company
  • Mentorship, professional development, and networking opportunities
  • Discover highlights from our internship program on Instagram — follow us @InCommInterns


Responsibilities

  • Ensure compliance with internal policies and external regulations, while assisting in the preparation of HR and recruitment-related reports.
  • Maintain and update employee databases, gather and analyze HR data, and contribute to ongoing reporting efforts.
  • Support the onboarding process by coordinating new hire communications and facilitating smooth integration into the company.
  • Contribute to the execution of key Talent Acquisition initiatives, serving as a dedicated resource to help drive project progress and meet critical deadlines.
  • Develop and deliver advanced reports and dashboards to support data-driven decision-making across HR and partner departments.
  • Create documentation (video or SOPs) around Talent Acquisition processes.



Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a degree in Business or Human Resources, or a related field within your penultimate or final year of study.
  • Above average academic track record
  • Professional English and Portuguese Language skills are required. Ability to communicate clearly and professionally, both in writing and verbally
  • Must be self-motivated, ability to prioritize effectively and not shy away to seek guidance when you are blocked on a task
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel
  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Proven ability to manage multiple tasks and thrive in high-pressure, fast-paced environments
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities and critical thinking skills
  • Comfortable working independently and collaboratively, maintaining a positive and adaptable attitude
  • Self-motivated and energetic, with the ability to take initiative and work with minimal supervision


InComm Payments provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or national origin, citizenship, veteran’s status, age, disability status, genetics or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law.

title: Analista Funcional Senior (ERP, Logistica, WMS, TMS)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista Funcional Senior (ERP, Logistica, WMS, TMS) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Buscamos um(a) Analista Funcional Sênior para atuar entre negócio e tecnologia em projetos de TI/ERP, com vivência em logística (WMS e TMS). Você será responsável pelo levantamento, análise e documentação de requisitos funcionais, modelagem de processos (AS-IS/TO-BE) e garantia da qualidade das soluções por meio do suporte a testes (UAT) e validações. Atuação em report de status, alinhamento de evolução e comunicação das iniciativas em andamento junto a TI e fornecedores, garantindo visibilidade e organização das entregas.


Local

São Paulo/SP.

Viagens pontuais conforme necessidade do projeto.


Tipo de contratação

PJ


Responsabilidades


✅ Levantamento e Análise de Requisitos Funcionais:

* Conduzir workshops e entrevistas com stakeholders para entender necessidades e detalhar requisitos.

* Documentar requisitos funcionais, regras de negócio, casos de uso e critérios de aceite.


✅ Análise e Mapeamento de Processos (AS-IS / TO-BE):

* Mapear processos atuais (AS-IS), identificar melhorias e desenhar fluxos futuros (TO-BE).

* Garantir alinhamento entre processos, requisitos e soluções propostas.


✅ Atuação Funcional em Logística (WMS/TMS):

* Levantar e detalhar requisitos funcionais relacionados a processos logísticos (armazenagem, movimentação, expedição, transporte).

* Apoiar definições, alinhamentos e validações funcionais em iniciativas envolvendo WMS e TMS, incluindo integrações com ERP.


✅ Gestão de Testes e Validação (UAT):

* Planejar e apoiar a execução de testes funcionais e UAT, garantindo qualidade e aderência.

* Organizar evidências, acompanhar correções e validar entregas junto ao negócio.


✅ Status Report e Alinhamento de Evolução:

* Conduzir checkpoints de evolução com áreas envolvidas, garantindo clareza de próximos passos e pendências.

* Consolidar status do andamento (entregas, riscos, bloqueios, dependências) e comunicar de forma objetiva.

* Apoiar priorização e alinhamento de escopo junto ao negócio e TI.


✅ Documentação e Governança de Entregáveis:

* Manter documentação atualizada (processos, requisitos, decisões, impactos e entregáveis).

* Garantir padronização e organização dos artefatos do projeto.


Requisitos Obrigatórios


✔ Experiência sólida como Analista Funcional Sênior em projetos de TI/ERP e sistemas corporativos.

✔ Experiência com Logística, com vivência obrigatória em projetos/processos de WMS e TMS (implantação, evolução, rollout ou sustentação).

✔ Vivência em levantamento e documentação de requisitos (funcionais e regras de negócio).

✔ Experiência com mapeamento de processos (AS-IS/TO-BE) e documentação de fluxos.

✔ Participação em ciclos de testes (SIT/UAT), validação de entregas e suporte ao usuário de negócio.

✔ Experiência em rotinas de acompanhamento e comunicação de evolução (status, alinhamentos, priorização).

✔ Perfil comportamental desejado:

* Comunicação forte e capacidade de facilitar alinhamentos com diferentes públicos.

* Proatividade, autonomia e foco em resultado.

* Organização e atenção a detalhes na documentação e validação.

* Capacidade analítica para traduzir necessidades do negócio em soluções viáveis.


Diferenciais


✚ Experiência no setor de Varejo/Agronegócio (Varejo Agrícola).

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados- IA
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Pessoa Engenheira de Dados- IA em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Esta função é estratégica para nossas soluções de marketing orientadas a dados. Buscamos alguém que combine domínio técnico em engenharia de dados com afinidade real por inteligência artificial e experiência prática com Databricks.


Principais Atribuições


  • Desenvolve e mantém pipelines de dados em Databricks, usando PySpark e Delta Lake para ingestão, transformação e disponibilização de dados em escala.
  • Constrói e sustenta fluxos ETL/ELT robustos, com foco em qualidade, rastreabilidade e performance.
  • Aplica conceitos de IA e Machine Learning no contexto de dados de marketing, colaborando com times de ciência de dados na preparação e feature engineering de datasets.
  • Escreve SQL e código Python com qualidade de produção, incluindo testes unitários e revisão técnica.
  • Contribui para arquiteturas de Data Lakehouse, incluindo organização de camadas (Bronze/Silver/Gold) e governança de dados.
  • Participa de revisões de projeto e código, propondo melhorias técnicas com consistência.


Requisitos e Qualificações


  • Experiência sólida com Databricks (notebooks, clusters, Jobs, Unity Catalog).
  • Domínio de SQL e Python para manipulação e transformação de dados.
  • Conhecimento em PySpark e Delta Lake.
  • Experiência com ferramentas e conceitos de ETL/ELT.
  • Familiaridade com práticas de MLOps ou integração de modelos de IA em pipelines de dados.
  • Entendimento de infraestrutura de dados: armazenamento em nuvem, orquestração de jobs e controle de versão.
  • Afinidade com metodologias de desenvolvimento ágil e boas práticas de engenharia de software.


Diferencial


  • Experiência com plataformas de nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) integradas ao Databricks.
  • Conhecimento em LLMs, embeddings ou pipelines de dados para aplicações generativas.
  • Conhecimento em espanhol.



O que você vai encontrar por aqui:

  • Plano de saúde e Odontológico Sulamérica extensivo a dependentes

Parte da dentsu, dentsu internacional com sede em Londres, opera em mais de 145 mercados no mundo inteiro com mais de 48.000 colaboradores. Ajudamos nossos clientes a conquistar, manter e fazer crescer seus consumidores e alcançar um progresso significativo para os seus negócios. Com os melhores serviços e soluções em mídia, CXM, e criatividade.

Ao longo do caminho, você se unirá a colegas inspiradores e encontrará uma riqueza de clientes, culturas e experiências. Oferecemos desafios motivadores, experiências memoráveis e oportunidades para moldar seu futuro.


Inclusão e Diversidade

Estamos orgulhosos de ser diferente e isso começa com nossa gente. Acreditamos na igualdade de oportunidades para todos e não definimos as pessoas por sua raça, sexo, orientação sexual, idade ou deficiência. Portanto, quer você se junte a nós, quer procure mudar para uma parte diferente do negócio, nós trabalhamos duro para garantir a criação de oportunidades iguais para todos.


Nossas 8 maneiras

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Data Analyst em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us:

Toluna is the global research and insights leader that enables businesses to make smarter, data-driven decisions—faster. For 26 years, we have partnered with the world’s leading brands, delivering transformative impact through our advanced technology platform, comprehensive solution portfolio, expansive global first-party panel, and world-class team of leading research experts. Since 2019, we’ve made significant investments in artificial intelligence to enhance automation, accelerate insight delivery, and unlock deeper understanding at scale. With 40+ offices worldwide, Toluna operates in 70+ countries, redefining the future of insights. Learn


Introduction:

We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our global advanced analytics team. In this role, you’ll lead the design and execution of advanced analytical solutions that inform strategic decision-making for our clients. You’ll leverage your deep technical expertise and market research experience to drive innovation, mentor junior analysts, and deliver impactful, data-driven recommendations.


This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate analytics professional who thrives at the intersection of data science, business strategy, and storytelling, with growing expectations around applied AI and intelligent automation.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design and implementation of advanced analytical frameworks to address complex business challenges across a variety of industries.
  • Partner with internal teams and clients to translate business objectives into analytical solutions, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities.
  • Design, build, and maintain practical analytics-facing AI-enabled solutions such as analytical agents, automated insights generation, or decision support tools using large language models or similar technologies.
  • Evaluate where AI can responsibly augment analytical work, including data preparation, model development, quality checks, insight synthesis, and delivery, while maintaining methodological rigor.
  • Partner with engineering, analytics, or product teams to operationalize AI-driven analytics in repeatable and scalable ways.
  • Deliver high-impact storytelling and visualization, distilling complex analyses into clear narratives that influence senior stakeholders.
  • Act as a trusted consultant, providing analytic guidance and thought leadership on market research methodologies, data interpretation, and advanced modeling.
  • Mentor and support junior analysts, reviewing outputs, sharing best practices, and fostering a culture of learning and quality.
  • Champion automation, standardization, and innovation, identifying opportunities to optimize workflows and analytical efficiency.
  • Stay current on emerging tools, data science techniques, and market trends to continuously enhance Toluna’s analytics capabilities.


Your profile:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data analytics, advanced analytics, or market research roles.
  • Bachelor’s or master's degree in data science, statistics, economics, computer science, or a related field.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python, R, SQL, SPSS and/or Sawtooth
  • Strong command of statistical modeling, segmentation, predictive analytics, and experimental design.
  • Proven ability to lead analytical projects from scoping to delivery, including stakeholder management and quality assurance.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, able to translate complex data findings into business implications.
  • Hands-on experience applying AI or machine learning in real-world analytics contexts, beyond academic or purely experimental work.
  • Familiarity with large language models and their practical use in analytics workflows, such as building or supervising AI agents, prompt-driven analysis, or automated insight generation.
  • Strong judgment around model quality, bias, explainability, and appropriate use of AI in client-facing analytical work.
  • Ability to clearly explain AI-driven approaches and limitations to non-technical stakeholders in plain business language.
  • Experience mentoring or leading junior analysts or cross-functional workstreams.
  • Must be fluent in English , with additional languages being a plus.


**Please submit your CV in English.


Our Values:

  • A cting with Ownership- Demonstrating individual accountability
  • B ringing a forward mindset- Being action-oriented, bold and entrepreneurial
  • C ollaborating with Curiosity- Exhibiting teamwork through togetherness
  • D iscussing openly, committing jointly- Sharing your views openly
  • E mbracing empathy- Being egoless & caring


What we offer:

At Toluna, we’re all about creating a welcoming, diverse workplace where everyone can thrive. We offer competitive pay, great benefits, and plenty of opportunities to grow within our global team. Inclusion and respect are at the heart of what we do. Our community connects over 72 million people across 70 countries. If you’re passionate about making an impact, we’d love to have you on board.


Other Benefits: Healthcare, dental care, life insurance, a meal voucher, a transportation voucher, and a language class subsidy.


Join our global team. We welcome big thinking and reward great work.

description:

Engenheiro de Informática

title: Analista de Planejamento Financeiro Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Planejamento Financeiro Sênior em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Responsabilidades

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Planejamento Financeiro Sênior para integrar o time de uma empresa de que presta serviço de BPO Financeiro, consultoria e serviços de CFO Service nos EUA, atuando como peça-chave na gestão financeira estratégica de uma carteira de clientes de diferentes portes, segmentos e níveis de maturidade.

Este profissional será responsável por conduzir, de forma autônoma e estruturada, processos de planejamento, orçamento, análise de desempenho e geração de insights financeiros para múltiplas empresas simultaneamente, atuando como referência técnica e parceiro estratégico dos sócios e gestores dos clientes atendidos.


Planejamento e Orçamento

  • Conduzir o processo de orçamento anual (budget) , revisões orçamentárias (forecast) e planejamento de longo prazo das empresas da carteira.
  • Estruturar e manter modelos financeiros de DRE gerencial, fluxo de caixa projetado, balanço patrimonial e análise de cenários (base, otimista, conservador).

Apoiar a definição de metas, KPIs financeiros e operacionais alinhados às estratégias de cada cliente


Análise de Desempenho e Reporting

  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais mensais (Management Reports) com análise de variação realizado vs. orçado, drivers de resultado e recomendações de melhoria.
  • Construir e manter dashboards financeiros e painéis de indicadores (KPIs) para acompanhamento contínuo da performance dos clientes.

Realizar análises ad-hoc de rentabilidade por produto, cliente, canal, unidade de negócio ou centro de custo.


Gestão Financeira Multiempresa

  • Atuar como business partner de múltiplos clientes simultaneamente, organizando agenda, prazos, entregas e priorizações de forma independente.
  • Conduzir reuniões de resultado com sócios, diretores e gestores das empresas atendidas, traduzindo números em recomendações claras e acionáveis.

Identificar gargalos, riscos financeiros e oportunidades de melhoria nas operações dos clientes.


Processos, Controle e Melhoria Contínua

  • Padronizar e otimizar processos de planejamento financeiro dentro da carteira atendida, propondo melhorias contínuas.
  • Apoiar a estruturação de plano de contas gerencial , centros de custo e rateios que reflitam corretamente a operação de cada cliente.

Garantir a integridade, consistência e qualidade das informações financeiras geradas, atuando próximo às áreas de contabilidade, contas a pagar/receber e tesouraria.


Qualificações

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência comprovada em Planejamento Financeiro, FP&A, Controladoria ou Consultoria Financeira.
  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Engenharia, Finanças ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação, MBA ou certificações em Finanças, Controladoria, FP&A, CFA, CGMA ou equivalentes.
  • Experiência prática com construção de orçamento, forecast, DRE gerencial e fluxo de caixa projetado .
  • Domínio avançado de Excel (modelagem financeira, fórmulas complexas, tabelas dinâmicas, Power Query).
  • Vivência em gestão simultânea de múltiplas empresas, clientes ou unidades de negócio — experiência em BPO Financeiro, consultoria, family office, holding ou auditoria é altamente desejável.
  • Capacidade comprovada de trabalhar de forma autônoma , gerenciando o próprio tempo, prioridades e entregas em ambiente 100% remoto.
  • Inglês nível avançado/ fluente (usará inglês no dia a dia).


Perfil Compartimental (o que esperamos de você)

  • Autonomia e protagonismo: capacidade de conduzir o trabalho de ponta a ponta com mínima supervisão, propondo soluções em vez de apenas reportar problemas.
  • Pensamento analítico e crítico: habilidade de interpretar números, questionar premissas, identificar inconsistências e enxergar a história por trás dos dados.
  • Resolução de problemas: postura proativa para destravar entregas, lidar com ambiguidade e propor caminhos práticos diante de cenários complexos.
  • Organização e disciplina: capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas demandas, prazos e clientes simultaneamente sem perder qualidade ou prazo.
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva: habilidade de traduzir análises técnicas em mensagens compreensíveis para sócios e gestores de diferentes níveis.
  • Postura consultiva: atuação como parceiro estratégico do cliente, e não apenas como executor de relatórios.

Maturidade profissional e ética: discrição no trato com informações sensíveis e confidenciais.


Diferenciais

Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Looker Studio, Tableau).

Conhecimento em ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial

title: desenvolvedor sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para desenvolvedor sênior em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

olá, dev sênior | Node.js & React!


somos a teceo, a plataforma unificada de comércio B2B que conecta marcas e lojistas, a qualquer hora, de qualquer lugar. uma empresa jovem com um sonho grande: transformar o atacado da moda brasileira.


a teceo tem uma plataforma com muito sendo construído: catálogo, pedido, integrações com ERPs, políticas comerciais, sell-out, webhooks, gateway de pagamento. o volume de produto é alto e a complexidade técnica também. aqui dev precisa entender o negócio!


esse cargo é pra quem tem maturidade pra tomar decisões técnicas com autonomia, questionar arquitetura quando faz sentido, e traduzir um desafio de negócio em solução sem precisar de muita mão na mão. você vai trabalhar num time fullstack com um fluxo de desenvolvimento orientado a IA, onde ferramentas como claude code, open code e agentes de code review fazem parte do dia a dia, e esperamos que você saiba tirar proveito disso.


para fazer parte do time, buscamos pessoas que queiram se desafiar e sair da zona de conforto, ajudando a construir uma plataforma que está mudando como o atacado da moda funciona no Brasil.


o que você vai fazer

  • projetar e desenvolver novas funcionalidades com foco em qualidade e escalabilidade
  • criar e manter testes automatizados (unitários, funcionais e de integração)
  • discutir arquitetura, tecnologias e caminhos técnicos com o time
  • traduzir desafios de negócio em soluções técnicas simples e eficientes
  • contribuir para a evolução técnica do time
  • participar das cerimônias ágeis
  • apoiar o time de suporte em dúvidas técnicas quando necessário


fluxo de desenvolvimento orientado a IA

na teceo, IA não é palavra da moda — é ferramenta de trabalho:

  • geração de documentações de negócio e especificações técnicas com IA
  • uso de claude code, open code e outras ferramentas no processo de codificação
  • code review e refinamento via agentes (ex: coderabbit)
  • correção de bugs com apoio de agentes


o que procuramos em você

  • sólido conhecimento em React e Node.js, com experiência em NestJS
  • experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e arquitetura REST
  • vivência com microsserviços e integrações entre sistemas
  • experiência com testes automatizados
  • desejável: CI/CD e configuração de Docker
  • boa comunicação verbal e escrita — você vai precisar se posicionar tecnicamente
  • ao menos 5 anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento fullstack


o que oferecemos

  • remuneração de R$ 9,5k a R$ 16k
  • contratação PJ
  • programa de partnership
  • bonificação semestral
  • cartão Swile e TotalPass
  • home-office
  • horários flexíveis
  • bootcamp teceo — imersão presencial anual com o time
  • fio-da-meada — rumos e números do negócio numa reunião trimestral
  • eventos: happy hours, learning days, torneios e por aí vai


nenhum bom negócio é feito sozinho. quer entrar pro time? fale com a gente!

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Python Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor(a) Python Sênior em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem somos nós?


Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:


  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Desenvolvedora Python para integrar nosso time de tecnologia e atuar na construção, evolução e sustentação de soluções backend robustas, escaláveis e bem arquitetadas.

Essa pessoa atuará no entendimento de requisitos, implementação de soluções técnicas, integrações e melhorias contínuas, sempre com foco em qualidade, escalabilidade e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.


Como será seu dia a dia?


  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações backend em Python, garantindo qualidade, performance e escalabilidade;
  • Atuar na evolução da arquitetura dos sistemas, contribuindo com decisões técnicas e boas práticas;
  • Criar e consumir APIs REST, garantindo integrações eficientes e bem documentadas;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com outros desenvolvedores, produto e stakeholders técnicos para transformar necessidades de negócio em soluções funcionais;
  • Realizar análises técnicas, refatorações e melhorias contínuas em sistemas existentes;
  • Apoiar tecnicamente o time, compartilhando conhecimento e ajudando na evolução coletiva.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:


  • Experiência sólida como desenvolvedor(a) backend com Python;
  • Vivência com frameworks como FastAPI, Flask ou Django;
  • Forte conhecimento em APIs REST, estruturas assíncronas e integrações entre sistemas;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais, especialmente PostgreSQL;
  • Familiaridade com Git, versionamento de código e boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Capacidade de atuar com autonomia, senso crítico e responsabilidade técnica;
  • Experiência com Docker, pipelines de CI/CD e ambientes em nuvem;
  • Experiência com mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ ou similares);
  • Experiência prática com desenvolvimento assistido por IA no dia a dia, utilizando ferramentas como Claude, Antigravity, Cursor, Codex ou similares.


Você irá se destacar se:


  • Vivência em arquiteturas distribuídas e sistemas de médio/grande porte;
  • Experiência prática com LangChain e/ou LangGraph;
  • Conhecimento em LLMs, embeddings e RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation).


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?


  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.


Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.

title: Senior Cisco UCS Engineer (REMOTE)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Cisco UCS Engineer (REMOTE) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Infrastructure Engineer - Cisco UCS expert to work remotely from anywhere in Brazil for a client in the US.


MUST BE fluent in English.


The Senior Infrastructure Engineer provides advanced technical expertise within the Managed Services organization and serves as a senior escalation point for complex infrastructure issues. This role is primarily focused on Cisco UCS compute, VMware vCenter/vSphere virtualization, and Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (VDI) environments.

In addition to resolving advanced incidents, this role contributes to technical leadership, root cause analysis, documentation, and the planning and implementation of infrastructure solutions delivered through Professional Services engagements.

Senior Infrastructure Engineers are expected to have deep expertise in the core technology areas listed below, with a broad understanding of adjacent infrastructure disciplines.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Own the full lifecycle of complex infrastructure incidents, from detection through resolution and post-incident review, ensuring accountability for technical outcomes, stability, and documentation.
  • Lead investigation and resolution of critical incidents, driving coordination across internal teams, vendors, and customer stakeholders.
  • Make technical decisions and take end-to-end ownership of infrastructure issues, driving resolution without reliance on further escalation.
  • Lead technical delivery of infrastructure projects, including scoping, estimation, design, and implementation.
  • Perform root cause analysis and develop long-term remediation strategies to prevent recurrence.
  • Validate and approve infrastructure changes, designs, and remediation strategies.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers.
  • Contribute to architecture documentation, diagrams, and operational runbooks.
  • Design and implement automation and process improvements to enhance reliability and operational efficiency.
  • Participate in change management and project planning activities.
  • Accurately track time and project activities within the company's time tracking system.



Requirements

  • 8+ years of IT Infrastructure experience.
  • MUST BE fluent in English.
  • Deep, hands-on experience with Cisco UCS — including blade/rack server administration, Fabric Interconnects, UCS Manager (UCSM) or Intersight, service profiles, and firmware management.
  • Deep experience with VMware vCenter and vSphere — including ESXi administration, vMotion, HA/DRS, distributed virtual switches, and VM lifecycle management.
  • Deep experience with Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD) or Citrix DaaS — including Delivery Controllers, StoreFront, NetScaler/ADC, machine catalogs, and VDA troubleshooting.
  • Strong experience troubleshooting complex multi-system infrastructure issues.
  • Experience designing and implementing infrastructure solutions.


Preferred

  • Experience with Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM) and enterprise voice/unified communications infrastructure.
  • Certifications such as Cisco CCNP/CCIE Data Center, VMware VCP-DCV, Citrix CCP-V, or equivalent cloud infrastructure certifications.
  • Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment with exposure to ITIL-based service delivery models.
  • Experience delivering customer-facing IT infrastructure projects.
  • Experience with enterprise storage platforms.
  • Familiarity with identity platforms (Active Directory, Okta), firewalls (Palo Alto, Cisco FTD), and backup/disaster recovery solutions is a plus.

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Network Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Network Engineer to work remotely from anywhere in Brazil for a client in the US.


MUST BE fluent in English.


The Senior Network Engineer provides advanced networking expertise within the Managed Services organization and serves as a subject matter expert and senior escalation point for complex network and firewall issues.

In addition to resolving advanced incidents, this role contributes to technical leadership, root cause analysis, documentation, and the planning and implementation of network solutions delivered through Professional Services engagements.

Senior Network Engineers are expected to have deep expertise in enterprise networking and advanced firewall management across multiple platforms, with a strong focus on security, stability, and scalability of client environments.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the full lifecycle of complex network and firewall incidents, from detection through resolution and post-incident review, ensuring accountability for technical outcomes, stability, and documentation.
  • Lead investigation and resolution of critical network incidents, driving coordination across internal teams, vendors, and customer stakeholders.
  • Make technical decisions and take end-to-end ownership of network issues, driving resolution without reliance on further escalation.
  • Lead technical delivery of network projects, including scoping, estimation, design, and implementation.
  • Perform root cause analysis and develop long-term remediation strategies to prevent recurrence.
  • Validate and approve network changes, designs, and remediation strategies.
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Cisco, Palo Alto, and Fortinet networking and firewall equipment.
  • Conduct targeted cleanup and improvements of existing network environments to ensure stability and scalability, minimizing customer downtime.
  • Collaborate with the security team to ensure proper network hardening is in place and that all risks are properly mitigated or remediated.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers.
  • Contribute to architecture documentation, diagrams, and operational runbooks.
  • Maintain awareness of developments within the networking and security technology landscape, recommending new solutions when necessary.
  • Accurately track time and project activities within the company's time tracking system.



Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience within an MSP, VAR, ISP, NOC, or enterprise IT environment, with a focus on troubleshooting and maintaining existing network infrastructure.
  • MUST BE fluent in English.
  • Advanced, hands-on experience managing enterprise firewalls across multiple platforms — including Cisco (ASA/FTD/FMC), Palo Alto Networks (PAN-OS, Panorama), and Fortinet (FortiGate, FortiManager) — including policy design, rule optimization, VPN configuration, and threat prevention.
  • Strong knowledge of networking protocols and technologies including TCP/IP, OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, IPSec, SNMP, STP, VTP, and VLANs.
  • Strong knowledge of network infrastructure within virtualized environments using VMware or similar platforms, including virtual networking, VLAN configurations, virtual switches, and network segmentation.
  • Experience troubleshooting performance and connectivity issues across different OSI layers.
  • Experience with application-level network troubleshooting, including packet inspection and analysis.
  • Proven experience optimizing, securing, and consolidating complex legacy network environments to meet current and future business needs.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a customer-first approach to resolving network issues.


Preferred

  • Active CCNP certification or equivalent (Palo Alto PCNSE or Fortinet NSE 4/7 also valued).
  • Experience with Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM) and enterprise voice/unified communications infrastructure.
  • Experience with cloud networking across AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including networking configurations, security settings, and integration with on-premises environments.
  • Experience with network security practices including network hardening, monitoring, and threat assessment.
  • Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment with exposure to ITIL-based service delivery models.
  • Experience delivering customer-facing IT network projects.
  • A degree or equivalent experience in computer science or a related field.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Data Analyst em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us:

Toluna is the global research and insights leader that enables businesses to make smarter, data-driven decisions—faster. For 26 years, we have partnered with the world’s leading brands, delivering transformative impact through our advanced technology platform, comprehensive solution portfolio, expansive global first-party panel, and world-class team of leading research experts. Since 2019, we’ve made significant investments in artificial intelligence to enhance automation, accelerate insight delivery, and unlock deeper understanding at scale. With 40+ offices worldwide, Toluna operates in 70+ countries, redefining the future of insights. Learn


Introduction:

We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our global advanced analytics team. In this role, you’ll lead the design and execution of advanced analytical solutions that inform strategic decision-making for our clients. You’ll leverage your deep technical expertise and market research experience to drive innovation, mentor junior analysts, and deliver impactful, data-driven recommendations.


This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate analytics professional who thrives at the intersection of data science, business strategy, and storytelling, with growing expectations around applied AI and intelligent automation.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design and implementation of advanced analytical frameworks to address complex business challenges across a variety of industries.
  • Partner with internal teams and clients to translate business objectives into analytical solutions, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities.
  • Design, build, and maintain practical analytics-facing AI-enabled solutions such as analytical agents, automated insights generation, or decision support tools using large language models or similar technologies.
  • Evaluate where AI can responsibly augment analytical work, including data preparation, model development, quality checks, insight synthesis, and delivery, while maintaining methodological rigor.
  • Partner with engineering, analytics, or product teams to operationalize AI-driven analytics in repeatable and scalable ways.
  • Deliver high-impact storytelling and visualization, distilling complex analyses into clear narratives that influence senior stakeholders.
  • Act as a trusted consultant, providing analytic guidance and thought leadership on market research methodologies, data interpretation, and advanced modeling.
  • Mentor and support junior analysts, reviewing outputs, sharing best practices, and fostering a culture of learning and quality.
  • Champion automation, standardization, and innovation, identifying opportunities to optimize workflows and analytical efficiency.
  • Stay current on emerging tools, data science techniques, and market trends to continuously enhance Toluna’s analytics capabilities.


Your profile:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data analytics, advanced analytics, or market research roles.
  • Bachelor’s or master's degree in data science, statistics, economics, computer science, or a related field.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python, R, SQL, SPSS and/or Sawtooth
  • Strong command of statistical modeling, segmentation, predictive analytics, and experimental design.
  • Proven ability to lead analytical projects from scoping to delivery, including stakeholder management and quality assurance.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, able to translate complex data findings into business implications.
  • Hands-on experience applying AI or machine learning in real-world analytics contexts, beyond academic or purely experimental work.
  • Familiarity with large language models and their practical use in analytics workflows, such as building or supervising AI agents, prompt-driven analysis, or automated insight generation.
  • Strong judgment around model quality, bias, explainability, and appropriate use of AI in client-facing analytical work.
  • Ability to clearly explain AI-driven approaches and limitations to non-technical stakeholders in plain business language.
  • Experience mentoring or leading junior analysts or cross-functional workstreams.
  • Must be fluent in English , with additional languages being a plus.


**Please submit your CV in English.


Our Values:

  • A cting with Ownership- Demonstrating individual accountability
  • B ringing a forward mindset- Being action-oriented, bold and entrepreneurial
  • C ollaborating with Curiosity- Exhibiting teamwork through togetherness
  • D iscussing openly, committing jointly- Sharing your views openly
  • E mbracing empathy- Being egoless & caring


What we offer:

At Toluna, we’re all about creating a welcoming, diverse workplace where everyone can thrive. We offer competitive pay, great benefits, and plenty of opportunities to grow within our global team. Inclusion and respect are at the heart of what we do. Our community connects over 72 million people across 70 countries. If you’re passionate about making an impact, we’d love to have you on board.


Other Benefits: Healthcare, dental care, life insurance, a meal voucher, a transportation voucher, and a language class subsidy.


Join our global team. We welcome big thinking and reward great work.

title: Analista de DHO/Treinamento

Aplicação e Gestão de Treinamentos

  • Organização de agendas, logística e inscrições.
  • Gestão de plataformas LMS.
  • Acompanhamento de certificações internas.


Avaliação de Eficácia

  • Aplicação de avaliações de reação e aprendizagem.
  • Medição de impacto (modelo Kirkpatrick ou similar).
  • Análise de indicadores de performance pós-treinamento.
  • Relatórios gerenciais para diretoria.


Compliance e Treinamentos Obrigatórios

  • Gestão de treinamentos obrigatórios (NRs, LGPD, ética, compliance).
  • Controle de validade e reciclagens.
  • Organização de evidências para auditorias.


Perfil Técnico

  • Experiência com treinamento corporativo.
  • Vivência com LMS (Moodle, SAP SuccessFactors, etc.).
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de aprendizagem de adultos (andragogia).
  • Experiência com treinamentos técnicos e/ou regulatórios.
  • Habilidade em criação de materiais didáticos.
  • Excel intermediário/avançado para controle de indicadores.


Perfil Comportamental

  • Comunicação clara e didática.
  • Organização e planejamento.
  • Criatividade.
  • Capacidade de engajar diferentes públicos.
  • Visão estratégica.
  • Postura consultiva com gestores.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com universidades corporativas.
  • Certificação em metodologias ágeis.
  • Experiência com trilhas técnicas (tecnologia, sistemas, compliance).
  • Experiência em ambientes regulados.
  • Vivência em empresas de tecnologia ou consultoria.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Python Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor(a) Python Sênior em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem somos nós?


Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:


  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Desenvolvedora Python para integrar nosso time de tecnologia e atuar na construção, evolução e sustentação de soluções backend robustas, escaláveis e bem arquitetadas.

Essa pessoa atuará no entendimento de requisitos, implementação de soluções técnicas, integrações e melhorias contínuas, sempre com foco em qualidade, escalabilidade e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.


Como será seu dia a dia?


  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações backend em Python, garantindo qualidade, performance e escalabilidade;
  • Atuar na evolução da arquitetura dos sistemas, contribuindo com decisões técnicas e boas práticas;
  • Criar e consumir APIs REST, garantindo integrações eficientes e bem documentadas;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com outros desenvolvedores, produto e stakeholders técnicos para transformar necessidades de negócio em soluções funcionais;
  • Realizar análises técnicas, refatorações e melhorias contínuas em sistemas existentes;
  • Apoiar tecnicamente o time, compartilhando conhecimento e ajudando na evolução coletiva.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:


  • Experiência sólida como desenvolvedor(a) backend com Python;
  • Vivência com frameworks como FastAPI, Flask ou Django;
  • Forte conhecimento em APIs REST, estruturas assíncronas e integrações entre sistemas;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais, especialmente PostgreSQL;
  • Familiaridade com Git, versionamento de código e boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Capacidade de atuar com autonomia, senso crítico e responsabilidade técnica;
  • Experiência com Docker, pipelines de CI/CD e ambientes em nuvem;
  • Experiência com mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ ou similares);
  • Experiência prática com desenvolvimento assistido por IA no dia a dia, utilizando ferramentas como Claude, Antigravity, Cursor, Codex ou similares.


Você irá se destacar se:


  • Vivência em arquiteturas distribuídas e sistemas de médio/grande porte;
  • Experiência prática com LangChain e/ou LangGraph;
  • Conhecimento em LLMs, embeddings e RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation).


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?


  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.


Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.

title: Editor de Vídeos
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Editor de Vídeos em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Vaga: Editor(a) de Vídeo Júnior — 100% Remoto | CLT + Plano de Saúde + Bônus


LEIA ATÉ O FINAL COM ATENÇÃO - NÃO ADIANTA SÓ CLICAR EM SE CANDIDATAR AQUI NO LINKEDIN


Em menos de 2 anos, possivelmente, já somos a maior clínica de fisioterapia pélvica particular do Brasil e nosso ritmo de crescimento é acelerado e cada vez mais rápido.


Conteúdo é um dos motores desse crescimento. Cada corte que sai da nossa edição educa pacientes, quebra tabus sobre disfunções íntimas e mostra que existe tratamento sério para problemas que a maioria dos lugares trata errado.


Agora estamos abrindo vaga para um(a) Editor(a) de Vídeo Júnior que queira entrar nesse time, aprender rápido e crescer junto.


O pacote


• Salário fixo: R$ 1.830


• Ajuda de custo: R$ 300


• Bônus mensal de até R$ 300 (por desempenho e comportamento)


• Plano de saúde


• Regime CLT, 100% remoto


Total possível inicial: até R$ 2.430/mês + plano de saúde.


Cargo Júnior. Mas não é uma vaga para quem quer ficar Júnior. Quem entrega, evolui rápido para Pleno — esse é o nosso jeito de operar em todos os cargos.


A vaga em uma frase


Assistir vídeos longos da PelvClinic, achar os melhores trechos e transformar em cortes curtos que prendem atenção no Reels, TikTok e Shorts.


A edição técnica importa. Mas escolher o corte certo importa mais. Saber identificar qual trecho começa forte, qual fala gera curiosidade, qual explicação tem valor — esse é o olhar que faz a diferença entre um editor comum e um editor que move o ponteiro.


É isso que vamos te ensinar e cobrar.


Como você vai trabalhar


Você será liderado(a) pela Emilly, nossa Social Media, que vai te orientar no dia a dia: demanda, feedback, padrão de qualidade, prioridades.


Trabalho remoto exige maturidade. Você precisa ter:


• Computador próprio com capacidade real para edição


• Boa internet


• Organização para entregar sem ser lembrado


• Disponibilidade para alinhamentos com a Emilly


Se você precisa de cobrança constante para produzir, essa vaga não é pra você.


O que estamos buscando


Três coisas — em ordem de importância:


1. Olho para conteúdo. Capacidade de assistir uma hora de vídeo e identificar os 30 segundos que prendem atenção sozinhos.


2. Constância. Entregar bem hoje, amanhã e na semana que vem. Não picos seguidos de sumiço.


3. Vontade real de crescer. Pessoa que estuda referência por conta própria, aceita feedback sem peso, aplica e volta melhor.


>>>Teste prático (Passo 1)<<<


Vídeo de explicação do teste:


A sua pontuação no teste terá base na qualidade e quantidade de bons cortes e conteúdos que conseguir extrair de cada vídeo longo:


• Vídeos curtos de alcance em formato 16:9 (geralmente de 20 segundos até 2 minutos — topo de funil)


• Vídeos médios de 2 a 7 minutos formato 16:9, mais completos e explicados, para gerar mais profundidade de relacionamento (meio e fundo de funil)


• Carrosséis, tanto dos vídeos longos base, quanto dos vídeos menores


FAQ: tem número de vídeos que vocês imaginam?


O teste é para ver a sua capacidade de extrair o maior número de bons conteúdos e ideias possível de cada vídeo longo (vídeos menores e posts/carrosséis).


P.S. Os vídeos já foram editados por nós, e essa será a régua para classificação.


Vídeos longos base (extrair vídeos curtos e carrosséis):


Vídeo 1:


Vídeo 2:


Quanto maior o número e a qualidade dos conteúdos, mais alta sua pontuação.


Penalização por conteúdos ruins ou fracos. Sem encher linguiça — o que conta é volume de conteúdos bons.


Critérios de avaliação:


• Seleção de tema e clareza da ideia


• Título / Headline escrito


• Gancho falado — força nos 0–3s e 0–7s, curiosidade e interesse sem clickbait


• Entrega de conteúdo — satisfação depois de consumir


• Comunicação da marca — ética, acolhimento, evidência, linguagem simples


• Velocidade e capricho — quanto mais rápido melhor, arquivos nomeados, zero ruído


Referências de vídeos curtos:

Corpo: ENVIE o Link (pasta no drive) dos conteúdos que você editou + currículo


Para quem essa vaga não é


• Quem quer trabalho remoto pra ficar tranquilo


• Quem precisa de cobrança constante pra entregar


• Quem reage a feedback como ataque


• Quem quer fazer o mínimo e receber o suficiente


Para quem essa vaga é

About Pyxus


We are a global company with more than 150 years of history, committed to creating a better-growing world. As part of the Pyxus group, Alliance One Brasil shares this vision, and we believe in a future where people are inspired to achieve excellence, communities are strengthened by trust and innovation, and value is created through a commitment to serve. description:

We are…

A leading digital media and content production group with a large global presence. At EMP, we believe in the power of content to unite and inspire people. With our innovative approach and content-first mentality, we're redefining how content is consumed and shared. We help create content at the highest level including some of the biggest professional athlete led podcasts in the world.


Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. EMP is a place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.


You Are...

An experienced and driven video editor professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

You Will...

  • Edit audio and video for podcast, YouTube videos, advertisments, branded content, Social content and more to create high-quality, color corrected, synchronized video content.
  • Ensure audio clarity, correct sync issues, and enhance sound quality with noise reduction, EQ, and other techniques.
  • Add intro/outro music, sound effects, and transitions for a professional and polished final product.

  • and more...

You Have...

  • The ability to speak advanced to fluent English
  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content.
  • Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.
  • Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

title: Headshots Retoucher
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Headshots Retoucher em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job description:

About Us

Headshots.com is transforming how professional headshots are delivered. Trusted by enterprise clients such as Boeing, Netflix, and American Express, we produce studio-quality headshots from smartphone images—backed by world-class production and technology.

Our retouching team is critical to delivering consistent, natural, high-quality results at scale. We are hiring experienced headshot retouchers for ongoing work who can handle high volume while maintaining realism, accuracy, and professional polish.


Role Overview

This role focuses on high-quality retouching of professional headshots sourced from mobile phone photos. You will work within established production standards to deliver natural, realistic results—preserving skin texture, correcting lighting issues, and ensuring consistency across batches.

Following a brief unpaid test project, selected candidates will invited for an interview, with the opportunity for long-term, steady work.


Core Responsibilities

Image Retouching & Quality Control

  • Retouch professional headshots from phone photos with a natural, realistic finish
  • Correct skin tone, noise, mixed lighting, exposure issues, and soft focus
  • Reduce or remove glasses glare while preserving realism
  • Perform background swaps and composites that look seamless and believable
  • Maintain consistency and quality across large batches of images


Production & Workflow Discipline

  • Deliver work on time and meet daily/weekly volume expectations
  • Follow established retouching guidelines and quality standards
  • Apply feedback consistently and efficiently
  • Communicate clearly if issues arise that could affect timelines or quality


Core Skills Required

  • Natural skin retouching (texture preserved; no plastic or over-processed look)
  • Clean hair masking and edge work (no halos)
  • Realistic background compositing
  • Strong color correction and exposure balancing, especially in uneven or mixed light
  • Excellent time management and consistency at scale
  • Strong written English (spoken English for occasional Zoom calls is a plus)


Hardware & Software Requirements (Must-Have)

  • Graphics tablet (Wacom, Huion, XP-Pen, or similar)
  • Legitimate Adobe Photoshop subscription (no cracked software)
  • MacBook Pro Retina or equivalent high-quality PC laptop display
  • Monitor accurate in sRGB (DCI-P3 support is a plus)


Volume, Timing & Pay

  • $5 USD per image
  • Expected volume after trial period: 100+ images/month, with potential to scale higher
  • The $2,000/month reference rate is based on completing approximately 20 headshots per day across 20 working days


Application Requirements (Read Carefully)

Apply by completing the test project:


Hiring Process

  • Applicants are asked to complete a brief unpaid test project
  • Successful test submissions will be invited to interview
  • Ongoing, consistent work available for high-performing retouchers
  • Direct inquiries will disqualify candidates. All applications must be submitted through Indeed.
  • Job Types: Full-time, Contract


IMPORTANT

All candidates must apply via LinkedIn. Direct contact with Headshots.com regarding this position will not be considered and may result in disqualification from the process.

title: Senior ML engineer | Fully remote | B2B
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior ML engineer | Fully remote | B2B em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who enjoys turning messy web data into structured, reliable company intelligence.


This is not a research role, management track or career step for people who mainly want to move up. It is a hands on engineering role for someone who gets satisfaction from solving complex data problems properly.


About us

Fullinfo is a self funded software company building a B2B company intelligence platform.

We continuously crawl the open web and turn unstructured company websites, directories, registries and industry sources into clean, searchable company profiles. The result is a global database where users can search for specific company data and actually get the right answer.

The product helps sales and marketing teams search across company data in a way that feels simple on the surface, but is technically complex underneath. Think natural language search, structured filters, company enrichment, relationship detection and reliable classification across many countries, industries and languages.


Fullinfo currently works with a compact team of around 11 people, including backend engineers, frontend engineers, UX UI designers, DevOps and machine learning specialists. The team is small, international and focused on people who actually build, improve and ship the product.

The culture is calm, direct and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say. There is little room for ego, politics or vague ambition talk. The best fit is someone who is quietly driven, technically strong and genuinely interested in building something that works well.

This is not the environment for people who constantly reinvent their profile, chase the next title or need a lot of structure around them. It is a strong fit for stable engineers who know their craft and like working with other people who take quality seriously.


Role description

As Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will work on the intelligence layer at the heart of Fullinfo’s product.


Your work turns raw, noisy and unstructured web content into trustworthy data points. This includes things like industry classification, company maturity stage, tech stack, geography served, corporate hierarchy, entity matching and relationship detection.

You will write Python, build and improve ML pipelines, integrate LLMs, evaluate model quality and make sure the system keeps producing accurate results at scale.


The stack includes Python, Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers, boto3, AWS Lambda, SageMaker, S3, ECS, Terraform, Go and TypeScript.

You will work closely with a small engineering team, but this is not a role where someone tells you every step to take. The direction is clear, the expectations are high, and the work needs to be done properly. You need to be comfortable figuring things out, validating assumptions and improving quality without needing constant confirmation.


Your work includes:

• Designing and improving models for classification, entity resolution and relationship detection

• Working with noisy web scraped data across many languages and formats

• Building ML pipelines that run reliably in production

• Using LLMs for extraction, enrichment, validation and search related use cases

• Working with embeddings, RAG, fine tuning and prompt engineering where it actually adds value

• Defining evaluation metrics so model quality is measurable instead of based on gut feeling

• Monitoring deployed models and improving them over time

• Working with AWS services such as Lambda, SageMaker, S3 and ECS

• Collaborating with backend engineers on production systems and data flows


This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys deep technical problems more than status. Someone who would rather fix a broken classification result than talk about building a team under them.


Requirements

You bring:

• At least 5 years of hands on ML engineering experience

• Strong Python skills

• Experience with libraries such as Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers and boto3

• Real production experience with ML on AWS

• Experience with LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering or fine tuning

• Comfort working with large scale, messy and semi structured data

• Experience with JSON, NoSQL data and scraped web content

• A strong eye for correctness and data quality

• Business level English

• The ability to work independently in a small remote team

• A stable track record that shows depth, consistency and ownership


Conditions

• 12 month B2B contract

• Fully remote work (GMT -3), you are allowed to have a 3 hour overlap

• Flat structure with direct communication

• Production product with real users and real data problems

• Strong technical challenge around ML, LLMs, search and company intelligence

• Compensation based on senior contractor level


The hiring process includes an intro call, a technical assignment and a final conversation with the engineering team.


Interested? Apply trough the link and get in touch with our consultant Lars

Fullinfo is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match Fullinfo’s needs.

description:

Job description:

About Us

Headshots.com is transforming how professional headshots are delivered. Trusted by enterprise clients such as Boeing, Netflix, and American Express, we produce studio-quality headshots from smartphone images—backed by world-class production and technology.

Our retouching team is critical to delivering consistent, natural, high-quality results at scale. We are hiring experienced headshot retouchers for ongoing work who can handle high volume while maintaining realism, accuracy, and professional polish.


Role Overview

This role focuses on high-quality retouching of professional headshots sourced from mobile phone photos. You will work within established production standards to deliver natural, realistic results—preserving skin texture, correcting lighting issues, and ensuring consistency across batches.

Following a brief unpaid test project, selected candidates will invited for an interview, with the opportunity for long-term, steady work.


Core Responsibilities

Image Retouching & Quality Control

  • Retouch professional headshots from phone photos with a natural, realistic finish
  • Correct skin tone, noise, mixed lighting, exposure issues, and soft focus
  • Reduce or remove glasses glare while preserving realism
  • Perform background swaps and composites that look seamless and believable
  • Maintain consistency and quality across large batches of images


Production & Workflow Discipline

  • Deliver work on time and meet daily/weekly volume expectations
  • Follow established retouching guidelines and quality standards
  • Apply feedback consistently and efficiently
  • Communicate clearly if issues arise that could affect timelines or quality


Core Skills Required

  • Natural skin retouching (texture preserved; no plastic or over-processed look)
  • Clean hair masking and edge work (no halos)
  • Realistic background compositing
  • Strong color correction and exposure balancing, especially in uneven or mixed light
  • Excellent time management and consistency at scale
  • Strong written English (spoken English for occasional Zoom calls is a plus)


Hardware & Software Requirements (Must-Have)

title: K-POP Influencers
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para K-POP Influencers em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. K-POP & K-DRAMA Influencer Growth CreatorPowered by IZISURFAbout IZISURF

IZISURF is building a next-generation creator growth ecosystem focused on K-POP, K-Drama, Korean entertainment, and global fan communities. Our mission is to help passionate creators transform their content into scalable global media brands through audience growth, AI-powered optimization, fan engagement strategies, and cross-platform expansion.

We believe that the future of entertainment media belongs to creators who deeply understand fandom culture, digital storytelling, and internet trends. As Korean entertainment continues to influence global culture, we are creating an infrastructure that helps influencers grow faster, engage audiences more effectively, and unlock meaningful monetization opportunities.

Unlike traditional influencer agencies, IZISURF operates as a creator growth partner. We actively work alongside creators to optimize content performance, identify viral opportunities, improve audience retention, and expand creator reach across multiple social media platforms. Our goal is not only to help creators gain followers, but to help them build long-term digital brands with sustainable growth.

Position Overview

We are looking for highly creative, trend-aware, and passionate K-POP & K-Drama Influencer Growth Creators who are excited about Korean entertainment culture and want to build a strong global online presence.

This role is ideal for individuals who genuinely enjoy discussing K-POP groups, idols, dramas, entertainment news, fan theories, comeback analysis, performances, concerts, and online fandom culture. Whether you are already an influencer or an emerging creator with strong potential, we are interested in working with people who can create authentic and engaging content that resonates with audiences worldwide.

As part of IZISURF, creators will receive strategic support designed to accelerate growth. Our team helps creators improve audience engagement, optimize content formats, analyze performance metrics, and identify viral content opportunities. We work collaboratively with creators to develop sustainable content strategies rather than focusing only on short-term trends.

Responsibilities

The selected creator will regularly produce engaging content related to K-POP, K-Dramas, Korean celebrities, entertainment culture, idol trends, music releases, and fan discussions. Content may include reactions, commentary, reviews, rankings, livestream discussions, entertainment analysis, short-form videos, and community engagement activities.

Creators will publish content across platforms such as TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, YouTube, X (Twitter), Threads, and other emerging media channels. The role requires staying highly informed about ongoing entertainment trends, comeback schedules, drama releases, viral online discussions, and fandom activities.

In addition to content production, creators will collaborate closely with the IZISURF growth team to improve visibility and engagement. This includes reviewing analytics, refining content strategy, experimenting with new content formats, and participating in cross-platform growth campaigns. We encourage creators to continuously evolve their personal brand while maintaining authenticity and strong audience connection.

Creators may also participate in brand collaborations, entertainment campaigns, livestream events, fan engagement projects, and promotional activities related to Korean entertainment and digital culture.

What Makes This Opportunity Different

At IZISURF, we do not simply recruit influencers — we actively help creators grow.

Our team provides strategic support in audience development, content optimization, social media analytics, trend intelligence, and creator branding. We help creators identify what content performs best, how to improve audience retention, and how to scale engagement across multiple platforms.

Creators working with IZISURF may gain access to growth resources, collaboration opportunities, creator partnerships, AI-assisted content workflows, monetization strategies, and entertainment-related campaigns designed to increase visibility and accelerate growth.

We believe that many talented creators struggle not because of creativity, but because they lack access to proper growth infrastructure. IZISURF is designed to solve that problem by combining entertainment culture expertise with modern digital growth systems.

Preferred Qualifications

We are looking for individuals who are highly passionate about Korean entertainment culture and actively follow K-POP, K-Dramas, Korean celebrities, and fandom communities. Strong communication skills, creativity, consistency, and comfort appearing on camera are highly valuable for this role.

Experience with social media content creation is preferred, but we are also open to emerging creators who demonstrate strong potential, personality, and storytelling ability. Familiarity with short-form video platforms, editing tools, and internet culture trends is important.

Candidates who already maintain active social media accounts, fan communities, or entertainment-focused content channels are strongly encouraged to apply. Korean language skills are a plus but are not required.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who genuinely enjoys talking about Korean entertainment and naturally engages with online communities. You are someone who understands internet culture, stays updated on trends, and enjoys creating content that sparks discussion and engagement.

You are creative, ambitious, and interested in building a long-term digital presence rather than simply posting occasional entertainment updates. You are excited about growing alongside a team that actively supports creator development and digital brand expansion.

Most importantly, you understand fandom culture and can create content that feels authentic, relatable, and engaging to global audiences.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Product Designer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who are we?

Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.


Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing.


About the role

This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs.


You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here.



Key responsibilities

  • Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way.
  • Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable.
  • Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations.
  • Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome.
  • Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit.
  • Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you.
  • Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.


Must haves

  • 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly.
  • Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs.
  • Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency.
  • Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits.
  • Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma.
  • Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives.
  • Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.


Nice to have

  • Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar).
  • Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms.
  • Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar).
  • Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique.
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; JavaScript a plus.
  • Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

description:

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.

  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.
