For 26 years, we have partnered with the world’s leading brands, delivering transformative impact through our advanced technology platform, comprehensive solution portfolio, expansive global first-party panel, and world-class team of leading research experts. Since 2019, we’ve made significant investments in artificial intelligence to enhance automation, accelerate insight delivery, and unlock deeper understanding at scale. With 40+ offices worldwide, Toluna operates in 70+ countries, redefining the future of insights. Learn


Introduction:

We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our global advanced analytics team. In this role, you’ll lead the design and execution of advanced analytical solutions that inform strategic decision-making for our clients. You’ll leverage your deep technical expertise and market research experience to drive innovation, mentor junior analysts, and deliver impactful, data-driven recommendations.


This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate analytics professional who thrives at the intersection of data science, business strategy, and storytelling, with growing expectations around applied AI and intelligent automation.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design and implementation of advanced analytical frameworks to address complex business challenges across a variety of industries.
  • Partner with internal teams and clients to translate business objectives into analytical solutions, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities.
  • Design, build, and maintain practical analytics-facing AI-enabled solutions such as analytical agents, automated insights generation, or decision support tools using large language models or similar technologies.
  • Evaluate where AI can responsibly augment analytical work, including data preparation, model development, quality checks, insight synthesis, and delivery, while maintaining methodological rigor.
  • Partner with engineering, analytics, or product teams to operationalize AI-driven analytics in repeatable and scalable ways.
  • Deliver high-impact storytelling and visualization, distilling complex analyses into clear narratives that influence senior stakeholders.
  • Act as a trusted consultant, providing analytic guidance and thought leadership on market research methodologies, data interpretation, and advanced modeling.
  • Mentor and support junior analysts, reviewing outputs, sharing best practices, and fostering a culture of learning and quality.
  • Champion automation, standardization, and innovation, identifying opportunities to optimize workflows and analytical efficiency.
  • Stay current on emerging tools, data science techniques, and market trends to continuously enhance Toluna’s analytics capabilities.


Your profile:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data analytics, advanced analytics, or market research roles.
  • Bachelor’s or master's degree in data science, statistics, economics, computer science, or a related field.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python, R, SQL, SPSS and/or Sawtooth
  • Strong command of statistical modeling, segmentation, predictive analytics, and experimental design.
  • Proven ability to lead analytical projects from scoping to delivery, including stakeholder management and quality assurance.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, able to translate complex data findings into business implications.
  • Hands-on experience applying AI or machine learning in real-world analytics contexts, beyond academic or purely experimental work.
  • Familiarity with large language models and their practical use in analytics workflows, such as building or supervising AI agents, prompt-driven analysis, or automated insight generation.
  • Strong judgment around model quality, bias, explainability, and appropriate use of AI in client-facing analytical work.
  • Ability to clearly explain AI-driven approaches and limitations to non-technical stakeholders in plain business language.
  • Experience mentoring or leading junior analysts or cross-functional workstreams.
  • Must be fluent in English , with additional languages being a plus.


**Please submit your CV in English.


Our Values:

  • A cting with Ownership- Demonstrating individual accountability
  • B ringing a forward mindset- Being action-oriented, bold and entrepreneurial
  • C ollaborating with Curiosity- Exhibiting teamwork through togetherness
  • D iscussing openly, committing jointly- Sharing your views openly

title: Data Scientist - Especialista
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Scientist - Especialista em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na frente de Alocação/Abastecimento em varejo, com foco em decisão de estoque orientada por dados (reduzir ruptura/excesso e aumentar venda/margem com nível de serviço).

Essa posição é estratégica para evoluirmos a alocação como produto: vai do diagnóstico e modelagem até deploy, monitoramento, IA aplicada à decisão e mensuração de impacto, atuando em parceria com Produto, Engenharia/MLE, Planning, Logística e Negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento, evolução e operacionalização de modelos avançados de machine learning para problemas de negócio de alta complexidade.
  • Atuar em desafios de modelagem preditiva, incluindo previsão de demanda, identificação de padrões comportamentais, otimização e apoio à tomada de decisão.
  • Estruturar abordagens robustas de experimentação, validação e monitoramento de modelos, garantindo qualidade, confiabilidade e evolução contínua das soluções.
  • Construir pipelines analíticos escaláveis para preparação, transformação e exploração de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com times multidisciplinares para transformar problemas ambíguos em soluções analíticas aplicáveis e escaláveis.
  • Liderar discussões técnicas sobre arquitetura analítica, boas práticas de modelagem e evolução da disciplina de ciência de dados.
  • Explorar e desenvolver soluções baseadas em IA aplicada, incluindo agentes inteligentes, automação de processos analíticos e uso de modelos generativos quando fizer sentido para o problema.
  • Apoiar a operacionalização de soluções analíticas em produção, incluindo monitoramento, performance e governança.
  • Comunicar recomendações, aprendizados e trade-offs técnicos de forma clara para stakeholders técnicos e de negócio.
  • Atuar como referência técnica para o time, apoiando o desenvolvimento de outros cientistas por meio de mentorias, revisões técnicas e disseminação de conhecimento.


Requisitos Necessários

  • Experiência comprovada de 6 a 8 anos em projetos de ciência de dados.
  • Forte domínio de estatística, machine learning e experimentação.
  • Experiência sólida em modelagem preditiva aplicada a problemas complexos de negócio, incluindo previsão de demanda e séries temporais, com domínio de algoritmos de machine learning supervisionado como XGBoost, LightGBM e CatBoost.
  • Proficiência em Python e SQL para análise, modelagem e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Experiência com ambientes cloud e ecossistemas analíticos escaláveis (BigQuery, Airflow ou similares).
  • Capacidade de transformar problemas de negócio pouco estruturados em soluções analíticas robustas.
  • Experiência com implantação, monitoramento e evolução de modelos em produção.
  • Forte capacidade analítica, pensamento crítico e excelente comunicação com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Noções de MLOps.
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com IA generativa, LLMs e desenvolvimento de agentes.
  • Vivência com frameworks como LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI ou similares.
  • Experiência em varejo.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.

title: Cloud Systems Engineer/DevOps
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud Systems Engineer/DevOps em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Role Overview

We are seeking an expert-level, highly skilled Cloud Systems Engineer (DevOps) to serve as a GCP Specialist and technical builder for our Google Cloud ecosystem. This role requires more than administration; you must be capable of building architectural change, adjusting systems, and driving modernization efforts. You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of our GCP infrastructure, from complex networking to proactive cost optimization and resource scaling. A key responsibility is leading and running large-scale cloud migration projects, specifically from AWS to GCP.


The ideal candidate ensures our Compute Engine environment is lean, fast, and resilient while maintaining secure connectivity using both native and third-party VPN solutions.

The role’s primary focus demands deep GCP expertise, but candidates must also possess significant experience with AWS for successful migration

strategy.


Key Responsibilities

  • Infrastructure & Networking: Configure and maintain robust networking architectures, including Cloud DNS and Cloud NAT.
  • Linux System Administration: Manage and maintain the operating system environment on Compute Engine instances, including patching, configuration management, user account management, and troubleshooting core system issues.
  • VPN Management: Build and manage secure tunnels using Cloud VPN , pfSense virtual appliances, and CloudConnexa (OpenVPN) for flexible remote access.
  • Performance Monitoring: Utilize Google Cloud Operations Suite to monitor Compute Engine health. Identify bottlenecks and tune instances for peak performance.
  • Resource Management: Oversee persistent disks, snapshots, and storage buckets. Ensure high availability while purging unused resources to maintain environment hygiene.
  • Cost Optimization: Actively monitor billing dashboards, implement committed use discounts (CUDs), and right-size underutilized instances to maintain a lean budget.
  • Database Oversight: Provide support for PostgreSQL and Oracle environments, ensuring seamless integration and performance within the GCP ecosystem.
  • Security & Compliance : Enforce IAM roles and security best practices to protect the project perimeter


Required Qualifications

  • Certification: Active Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer certification.
  • Containerization Mastery: Strong expertise with Docker for containerizing applications, managing images, and troubleshooting container runtimes.
  • Scripting Mastery: High proficiency in Python or Bash for automating routine infrastructure tasks, reporting, and task scheduling.
  • Networking Expertise: Hands-on experience managing network routing, firewall rules, and site-to-site VPNs using pfSense and CloudConnexa.
  • Cloud Migration & Project Leadership: Proven experience leading and running application and data migrations from AWS to GCP. This includes the capability to own the end-to-end migration project life cycle and drive solutions.
  • Compute Engine Mastery: Deep understanding of VM lifecycles, custom machine types, and auto-scaling.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced English level (B2–C1 or higher)


Nice-to-Have

  • PostgreSQL Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with configuration, optimization, and query tuning.
  • Oracle Expertise: Experience managing or migrating Oracle database environments.
  • Data & Analytics: Familiarity with BigQuery.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:

AREENA is the all-in-one operating system for sports leagues. From scheduling and payments to real-time AI-generated highlights, we help organizers run smoother seasons while delighting players with pro-level digital experiences.


Our platform spans league operations, mobile apps, payments, streaming, AI-generated content, internal operational tooling, and emerging AI automation systems.

  • streaming workflows,
  • AI stat tracking,
  • automated highlights/content generation,
  • and internal AI operational agents


Must-Have Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience

  • Experience working with APIs, databases, and production-scale applications
  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • Comfortable owning large areas of a codebase independently
  • Strong debugging and systems-thinking skills
  • Able to move quickly while maintaining good engineering judgment
  • Highly proficient using AI coding tools/agents as part of daily development workflows
  • Startup mindset: proactive, resourceful, adaptable, and product-oriented


Nice to Have

  • Flutter or mobile app experience
  • GraphQL experience
  • MongoDB experience
  • Experience with AI/LLM tooling
  • Experience with video, streaming, or real-time systems
  • Interest in sports or sports technology
  • Previous startup experience


What We Offer

  • Competitive USD compensation
  • Fully remote role within Brazil
  • High ownership and direct impact on product direction
  • Small, highly collaborative team
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI and sports technology products
  • Fast-paced environment with significant autonomy and responsibility


Hiring Process (2–3 Weeks)

  • Intro conversation (30 min)

  • Technical deep dive (60–90 min)
  • Architecture discussion
  • Real-world debugging/system design conversation
  • Discussion of prior projects and ownership

Please include:

  • systems/products you personally owned end-to-end,

ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Network Engineer to work remotely from anywhere in Brazil for a client in the US.


MUST BE fluent in English.


The Senior Network Engineer provides advanced networking expertise within the Managed Services organization and serves as a subject matter expert and senior escalation point for complex network and firewall issues.

In addition to resolving advanced incidents, this role contributes to technical leadership, root cause analysis, documentation, and the planning and implementation of network solutions delivered through Professional Services engagements.

Senior Network Engineers are expected to have deep expertise in enterprise networking and advanced firewall management across multiple platforms, with a strong focus on security, stability, and scalability of client environments.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the full lifecycle of complex network and firewall incidents, from detection through resolution and post-incident review, ensuring accountability for technical outcomes, stability, and documentation.
  • Lead investigation and resolution of critical network incidents, driving coordination across internal teams, vendors, and customer stakeholders.
  • Make technical decisions and take end-to-end ownership of network issues, driving resolution without reliance on further escalation.
  • Lead technical delivery of network projects, including scoping, estimation, design, and implementation.
  • Perform root cause analysis and develop long-term remediation strategies to prevent recurrence.
  • Validate and approve network changes, designs, and remediation strategies.
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Cisco, Palo Alto, and Fortinet networking and firewall equipment.
  • Conduct targeted cleanup and improvements of existing network environments to ensure stability and scalability, minimizing customer downtime.
  • Collaborate with the security team to ensure proper network hardening is in place and that all risks are properly mitigated or remediated.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers.
  • Contribute to architecture documentation, diagrams, and operational runbooks.
  • Maintain awareness of developments within the networking and security technology landscape, recommending new solutions when necessary.
  • Accurately track time and project activities within the company's time tracking system.



Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience within an MSP, VAR, ISP, NOC, or enterprise IT environment, with a focus on troubleshooting and maintaining existing network infrastructure.
  • MUST BE fluent in English.
  • Advanced, hands-on experience managing enterprise firewalls across multiple platforms — including Cisco (ASA/FTD/FMC), Palo Alto Networks (PAN-OS, Panorama), and Fortinet (FortiGate, FortiManager) — including policy design, rule optimization, VPN configuration, and threat prevention.
  • Strong knowledge of networking protocols and technologies including TCP/IP, OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, IPSec, SNMP, STP, VTP, and VLANs.
  • Strong knowledge of network infrastructure within virtualized environments using VMware or similar platforms, including virtual networking, VLAN configurations, virtual switches, and network segmentation.
  • Experience troubleshooting performance and connectivity issues across different OSI layers.
  • Experience with application-level network troubleshooting, including packet inspection and analysis.
  • Proven experience optimizing, securing, and consolidating complex legacy network environments to meet current and future business needs.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a customer-first approach to resolving network issues.


Preferred

  • Active CCNP certification or equivalent (Palo Alto PCNSE or Fortinet NSE 4/7 also valued).
  • Experience with Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM) and enterprise voice/unified communications infrastructure.
  • Experience with cloud networking across AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including networking configurations, security settings, and integration with on-premises environments.
  • Experience with network security practices including network hardening, monitoring, and threat assessment.
  • Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment with exposure to ITIL-based service delivery models.
  • Experience delivering customer-facing IT network projects.
  • A degree or equivalent experience in computer science or a related field.

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


About the Role


Job Title: Annotation & Review Specialist

Employment Type: Freelance / Project-Based

Location: Remote (Work From Home)

Work Hours: Flexible; minimum commitment of 4–5 hours per day

Eligibility: Open to candidates with a High school or above degree

Language Required : Polish



We are seeking for detail-oriented and quality-focused individuals to join our team as Annotation & Review Specialists. This is a freelance, remote opportunity that offers flexible working hours.

The role involves understanding cultural and linguistic nuances, reviewing and annotating data, and following detailed project-specific guidelines to enhance AI performance and accuracy.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform annotation tasks on images and videos as per project guidelines.
  • Review annotated images and video content to ensure accuracy and quality standards are met.
  • Provide clear and constructive feedback on annotations and identify areas requiring correction or improvement.
  • Follow project instructions, workflows, and timelines consistently.
  • Maintain high attention to detail while handling large volumes of data.
  • Collaborate with the quality and project teams to improve annotation accuracy and efficiency.



Required Skills & Qualifications


  • High school or Bachelor’s degree in mandatory.
  • Ability to understand and follow detailed annotation guidelines.
  • Basic computer proficiency and familiarity with online tools/platforms.
  • Prior experience in annotation, data labeling, or quality review is an added advantage.


What Makes This Role Exciting


  • Fully remote opportunity , allowing you to work comfortably from home.
  • Flexible working hours (4–5 hours per day) to suit your schedule.
  • The chance to contribute to cutting-edge AI and Large Language Model (LLM) training initiatives , shaping the future of language technology.


Note:

For this role, you are required to complete the Internal assessment and English assessment within two (2) days from the date it is assigned to you.

title: Engenheiro de Informática
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de Informática em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Cargo:

Engenheiro de Informática


Visão geral:

Estamos procurando um engenheiro LIMS qualificado com sólida experiência em desenvolvimento de software de informática laboratorial em ambientes regulamentados, particularmente nos setores de ciências da vida, alimentos e petróleo e gás.


Responsabilidades:

· Desenvolvimento de LIMS: Traduzir os requisitos de negócios em projetos abrangentes para implementações de LIMS.

· Personalização do LIMS: Desenvolver e configurar código personalizado utilizando linguagens como Java, Python e LIMS Basic.

· Criação de interface: Fazer uso de APIs para construir interfaces REST/SOAP para integrações de sistemas.

· Relatórios: Projetar e gerar relatórios Jasper (ou Crystal) para análises e visualização de dados.

· Conectividade com instrumento: Garantir o fluxo de dados contínuo entre o LIMS e a instrumentação científica.

· Conformidade GxP: Apoiar iniciativas técnicas de LIMS em alinhamento com os padrões GxP.

· Colaboração: Trabalhar de perto com os usuários de negócios do cliente, principais partes interessadas e fornecedores para impulsionar o sucesso do projeto.

· Documentação e Treinamento: Criar e manter documentação técnica e materiais de treinamento para usuários do LIMS.


Qualificações:

· Bacharel em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Biotecnologia ou áreas afins em ciência ou engenharia.

· Mínimo de 1 ano de experiência em uma função de desenvolvimento LIMS.

· Experiência prévia com configuração de plataformas LIMS como LabWare, LabVantage, SampleManager, etc.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Software Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Software Engineer

Contract Length: 3-6 month (likely to extend)

Location: Remote (Will work US CT Working Hours)

Start Date: ASAP


A fast-growing AI and IoT software company is building predictive intelligence platforms for the residential infrastructure and home services industry. Their technology combines connected devices, machine learning, and data-driven software to help service providers proactively identify and prevent equipment failures before they happen.


They’re looking for a Software Engineer to help shape and scale their next-generation web platform across customer experiences, operational tooling, and AI-powered dashboards.


This is a high-ownership role within a small, high-calibre engineering team. They want someone who enjoys building products from scratch, understands systems and architecture, and can operate autonomously in a fast-moving startup environment.


Key Experience Needed

  • Experience building and scaling modern web applications
  • Strong TypeScript and modern web architecture experience
  • Experience building products from 0→1 through to scale
  • Experience with scalable frontend systems and design systems
  • Product-focused mindset with strong user and business understanding
  • Comfortable working across Product, Design, Backend, and AI teams
  • Able to work autonomously in fast-moving environments
  • Strong understanding of scalability, performance, and engineering best practices
  • Python/backend experience is highly desirable
  • Experience with AI, IoT, or data-heavy products is beneficial


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture and technical direction of the web platform
  • Build scalable customer-facing products, internal tooling, and AI dashboards
  • Develop shared frontend frameworks and platform infrastructure
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, AI, and Backend teams
  • Improve scalability, performance, and developer workflows
  • Help shape engineering standards and technical direction
  • Contribute hands-on across architecture, development, and problem solving
  • Mentor engineers and help elevate engineering quality


Software Engineer

Contract Length: 3-6 month (likely to extend)

Location: Remote (Will work US CT Working Hours)

Start Date: ASAP

description:

Responsável pelo levantamento de necessidades, desenvolvimento, implementação e avaliação de programas de capacitação, garantindo alinhamento estratégico entre desenvolvimento de pessoas e objetivos organizacionais.

Atua na construção de trilhas de aprendizagem, gestão de conteúdos técnicos e comportamentais, além de monitorar indicadores de eficácia dos treinamentos.

  • Mapeamento de cargos e competências.

  • Criação de materiais didáticos (apresentações, manuais, e-learning).

  • Aplicação de avaliações de reação e aprendizagem.

Compliance e Treinamentos Obrigatórios

  • Gestão de treinamentos obrigatórios (NRs, LGPD, ética, compliance).
  • Controle de validade e reciclagens.
  • Organização de evidências para auditorias.


Perfil Técnico

  • Experiência com treinamento corporativo.
  • Vivência com LMS (Moodle, SAP SuccessFactors, etc.).

  • Habilidade em criação de materiais didáticos.
  • Excel intermediário/avançado para controle de indicadores.


Perfil Comportamental

  • Comunicação clara e didática.
  • Organização e planejamento.
  • Criatividade.
  • Capacidade de engajar diferentes públicos.
  • Visão estratégica.
  • Postura consultiva com gestores.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com universidades corporativas.
  • Certificação em metodologias ágeis.
  • Experiência com trilhas técnicas (tecnologia, sistemas, compliance).
  • Experiência em ambientes regulados.
  • Vivência em empresas de tecnologia ou consultoria.

title: Desenvolvedor Ruby on Rails
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor Ruby on Rails em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Requisitos Obrigatórios


Experiência comprovada com Ruby e Ruby on Rails é essencial para o desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações web. É necessário ter habilidade em criar e consumir APIs REST , além de integrar sistemas eficazmente. O candidato deve possuir experiência com bancos de dados relacionais, como PostgreSQL ou MySQL . Familiaridade com o uso do Git e a prática de metodologias ágeis são cruciais. A capacidade de comunicação clara e eficiente e o trabalho em equipe são necessários para colaborar com times de produto, design e QA. Além disso, o candidato participará da definição de arquitetura e na aplicação de melhorias técnicas, precisando realizar testes, correções de bugs e code reviews.


Requisitos Desejáveis


Conhecimento em testes automatizados, especialmente com ferramentas como RSpec e Minitest , é considerado um diferencial. Experiência com soluções de cloud, como AWS , GCP ou Azure , será altamente valorizada. Familiaridade com Docker e práticas de CI/CD também são desejáveis e podem beneficiar o desenvolvimento contínuo e a implantação de software.


Resumo dos requisitos: Ruby, Ruby on Rails, APIs REST, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Git, RSpec, Minitest, AWS, GCP, Azure, Docker, CI/CD .

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Back-End
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor(a) Back-End em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Junte-se à transformação da saúde no Brasil com a Salux Technology!


A Salux Technology é uma HealthTech 100% brasileira pioneira em soluções inovadoras de gestão de saúde. Desde 1997, nossa missão tem sido democratizar a excelência em saúde, ajudando mais de 250 clientes em todo o país a alcançar resultados excepcionais ao aprimorar a gestão administrativa e clínica.


Em 2021, a Salux passou a fazer parte do Grupo SBPar, o que acelerou nossa jornada de expansão e inovação, consolidando nossa posição como referência em excelência na informatização e soluções tecnológicas para o setor de saúde.


Se você é movido por desafios e quer fazer a diferença em um ambiente dinâmico e em constante evolução, venha crescer conosco e impactar positivamente o futuro da saúde no Brasil!


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações back-end de alta complexidade, com foco em performance, escalabilidade e resiliência;
  • Atuar na construção e evolução de APIs RESTful e arquiteturas baseadas em microsserviços;
  • Participar ativamente da definição e evolução da arquitetura de sistemas;
  • Realizar code reviews, garantindo qualidade, boas práticas e aderência a padrões de desenvolvimento (clean code);
  • Apoiar e mentorar desenvolvedores(as) mais juniores, atuando como referência técnica no time;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com times de Produto, QA e demais áreas envolvidas;
  • Identificar, analisar e solucionar problemas de performance e escalabilidade;
  • Participar de decisões técnicas estratégicas e propor melhorias contínuas nos sistemas e processos.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Ensino superior completo em área de tecnologia;
  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento com .NET Core (C#);
  • Domínio de pelo menos uma linguagem complementar (JavaScript ou TypeScript);
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful e/ou arquiteturas de microsserviços;
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados, preferencialmente Oracle;
  • Experiência com controle de versão utilizando Git;
  • Aplicação de boas práticas de desenvolvimento, como clean code.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em práticas de DevOps e pipelines de CI/CD;
  • Experiência com containers (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Vivência atuando como referência técnica no time;
  • Conhecimento em documentação de APIs com Swagger.


Modalidade de contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ).

Modelo de trabalho: Atuação híbrida em São Paulo ou Porto Alegre, com possibilidade de trabalho remoto para demais regiões.


Nossos Benefícios:

title: Diretor de Sucesso na Implementação (Pedagogia)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Diretor de Sucesso na Implementação (Pedagogia) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Salário: R$10.000,00 a R$30.000,00 por mês.

Localização: 100% remoto, com possibilidade de trabalho presencial em São Paulo no futuro.

Tipo: Tempo integral

Viagens: Esta função exige viagens para visitar escolas, conduzir treinamentos e apoiar implementações.


Who We Are


A Liza é uma startup de EdTech que usa Inteligência Artificial para ajudar professores a economizar tempo e melhorar a gestão pedagógica. Nossa plataforma ajuda professores a planejar aulas, avaliar atividades, criar exercícios, organizar informações dos alunos e trabalhar de forma mais eficiente em suas rotinas escolares diárias.

Nossa equipe atua entre os Estados Unidos e o Brasil, combinando execução no estilo do Vale do Silício com profundo conhecimento do sistema educacional brasileiro.


Our Leadership


  • Lisa Zhang, Fundadora: fundadora internacional baseada no Vale do Silício
  • Fernando Cofiel, COO: ex-COO da Maple Bear por 9 anos, com experiência em operações escolares, escala e franquias
  • Rogério Luiz, CTO: PhD em Ciência da Computação com foco em Inteligência Artificial


About the Role


Estamos procurando um(a) Diretor(a) de Implementação e Sucesso, educador experiente para liderar a implementação da Liza em escolas e redes de ensino. Esta não é apenas uma função de treinamento de software. Precisamos de alguém que entenda professores, coordenadores, exigências da BNCC, rotinas de sala de aula e os desafios reais da implementação escolar.


Essa pessoa será a ponte entre nossa tecnologia, nosso time de produto e as escolas que utilizam a Liza.


O candidato ideal combina:

  • Apaixonado(a) por educação;
  • Conhecimento pedagógico sólido/ BNCC;
  • Habilidades de implementação e gestão de projetos;
  • Experiência em sucesso do cliente e construção de relacionamento;
  • Conforto com ferramentas digitais e plataformas de EdTech;
  • Bom/boa em explicar tecnologia de forma simples;
  • Confortável treinando professores e coordenadores;
  • Proativo(a) e capaz de resolver problemas com independência;
  • Confortável em um ambiente de startup acelerado;
  • Animado(a) para ajudar a construir uma plataforma educacional com Inteligência Artificial no Brasil;


What You Will Do:


Implementação em escolas

  • Liderar o onboarding de novas escolas e redes de ensino;
  • Criar planos de implementação, cronogramas e agendas de treinamento;
  • Coordenar com líderes escolares, coordenadores, professores e equipes internas;
  • Viajar para escolas quando necessário para treinamentos presenciais e suporte à implementação;


Treinamento de professores

  • Planejar e conduzir workshops remotos e presenciais;
  • Treinar professores sobre como usar a Liza para planejamento de aulas, atividades, avaliações, relatórios e preparação de aulas;
  • Criar exemplos práticos que mostrem como a plataforma economiza tempo e apoia o ensino;
  • Ajudar professores a adotarem a plataforma com clareza, paciência e confiança;


Alinhamento pedagógico

  • Garantir que o uso da plataforma esteja alinhado às competências da BNCC e aos objetivos de aprendizagem;
  • Apoiar coordenadores na conexão da Liza com o planejamento curricular e as rotinas escolares;
  • Ajudar escolas a usarem a Liza de forma prática, pedagógica e fácil de manter;


Sucesso do cliente e Adoção

  • Construir relacionamentos fortes com líderes escolares, coordenadores e professores;
  • Acompanhar adoção, uso, engajamento e feedback das escolas;
  • Identificar riscos cedo, como baixo uso, confusão, resistência ou falta de alinhamento;
  • Criar planos de ação para melhorar a adoção e o sucesso de longo prazo;


Feedbacks

  • Coletar feedback de professores, coordenadores e líderes escolares;
  • Traduzir necessidades das escolas em insights claros para o produto;
  • Trabalhar com as equipes de produto, tecnologia, vendas, sucesso do cliente e liderança;
  • Ajudar a melhorar a plataforma com base nas necessidades reais da sala de aula;


Processos e Relatórios

  • Criar materiais de treinamento, guias de onboarding, checklists e playbooks de implementação;
  • Acompanhar o progresso da implementação em várias escolas;
  • Preparar relatórios sobre adoção, riscos, feedback e próximos passos;
  • Ajudar a construir um modelo de implementação escalável para o crescimento futuro;


Requirement


  • Graduação em Pedagogia, Educação, Licenciatura ou área relacionada;
  • 8+ anos de experiência em educação, coordenação pedagógica, implementação de EdTech, sucesso do cliente, consultoria educacional ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Experiência prévia trabalhando diretamente com escolas como professor(a), coordenador(a), consultor(a) ou líder de implementação;
  • Forte conhecimento da BNCC e das exigências curriculares brasileiras;
  • Experiência com educação infantil e/ou ensino fundamental é um grande diferencial;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, apresentação e treinamento;
  • Fortes habilidades de gestão de projetos e organização;
  • Conforto para gerenciar múltiplas implementações escolares ao mesmo tempo;
  • Conforto no uso de ferramentas digitais, plataformas de software, dashboards e produtos de EdTech;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar remotamente com disciplina e independência;
  • Disponibilidade para viajar para escolas quando necessário;
  • Português fluente obrigatório;


Preferred qualifications


  • Proficiência em inglês será um grande diferencial;
  • Pós-graduação em Design Instrucional, Tecnologia Educacional, Gestão Pedagógica ou Liderança Escolar;
  • Experiência prévia em EdTech, SaaS, Sucesso do Cliente, Implementação ou Consultoria Educacional;
  • Experiência implementando ferramentas digitais em escolas ou redes de ensino;
  • Experiência liderando programas de formação de professores ou workshops de desenvolvimento profissional;
  • Experiência trabalhando com redes de escolas privadas, sistemas públicos de ensino ou secretarias municipais de educação;
  • Experiência criando materiais de treinamento, guias de onboarding ou playbooks de implementação;

description:

Construir análises e dashboards que permitam monitorar o funil de vendas e a performance dos canais digitais e de growth, apoiando decisões estratégicas e garantindo que a ConCrédito aproveite ao máximo sua base de clientes.

  • Implementar ou propor soluções criativas utilizando Inteligência Artificial aplicada a dados.

O que buscamos:

  • Experiência sólida com SQL avançado.
  • Experiência com DBT.
  • Vivência com Snowflake.
  • Experiência em Power BI e Metabase para criação de dashboards e análises.
  • Forte capacidade analítica, com foco em funil de vendas e KPIs de conversão.
  • Boa comunicação para traduzir dados complexos em informações claras para diferentes áreas do negócio.
  • Perfil proativo.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com uso de Inteligência Artificial aplicada a dados.
  • Background em estatística ou modelagem preditiva.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados- IA
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Pessoa Engenheira de Dados- IA em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Esta função é estratégica para nossas soluções de marketing orientadas a dados. Buscamos alguém que combine domínio técnico em engenharia de dados com afinidade real por inteligência artificial e experiência prática com Databricks.


Principais Atribuições


  • Desenvolve e mantém pipelines de dados em Databricks, usando PySpark e Delta Lake para ingestão, transformação e disponibilização de dados em escala.
  • Constrói e sustenta fluxos ETL/ELT robustos, com foco em qualidade, rastreabilidade e performance.
  • Aplica conceitos de IA e Machine Learning no contexto de dados de marketing, colaborando com times de ciência de dados na preparação e feature engineering de datasets.
  • Escreve SQL e código Python com qualidade de produção, incluindo testes unitários e revisão técnica.
  • Contribui para arquiteturas de Data Lakehouse, incluindo organização de camadas (Bronze/Silver/Gold) e governança de dados.
  • Participa de revisões de projeto e código, propondo melhorias técnicas com consistência.


Requisitos e Qualificações


  • Experiência sólida com Databricks (notebooks, clusters, Jobs, Unity Catalog).
  • Domínio de SQL e Python para manipulação e transformação de dados.
  • Conhecimento em PySpark e Delta Lake.
  • Experiência com ferramentas e conceitos de ETL/ELT.
  • Familiaridade com práticas de MLOps ou integração de modelos de IA em pipelines de dados.
  • Entendimento de infraestrutura de dados: armazenamento em nuvem, orquestração de jobs e controle de versão.
  • Afinidade com metodologias de desenvolvimento ágil e boas práticas de engenharia de software.


Diferencial


  • Experiência com plataformas de nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) integradas ao Databricks.
  • Conhecimento em LLMs, embeddings ou pipelines de dados para aplicações generativas.
  • Conhecimento em espanhol.



O que você vai encontrar por aqui:

  • Plano de saúde e Odontológico Sulamérica extensivo a dependentes
  • Seguro de vida
  • VR ou VA
  • Auxílio home office
  • Auxílio Creche (para filhos até 5 anos e 11 meses);
  • Plataforma de Aprendizagem eLearning (Dentsu university)
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento de Carreira
  • Parceria para desenvolvimento de idiomas, especialização, pós-graduação e MBA
  • Programas de desenvolvimento local e Global
  • Day Off de Aniversário;



Sobre a dentsu internacional

Parte da dentsu, dentsu internacional com sede em Londres, opera em mais de 145 mercados no mundo inteiro com mais de 48.000 colaboradores. Ajudamos nossos clientes a conquistar, manter e fazer crescer seus consumidores e alcançar um progresso significativo para os seus negócios. Com os melhores serviços e soluções em mídia, CXM, e criatividade.


Trabalhando conosco

Juntando-se à dentsu international, você se juntará a um grupo de 48.000 pessoas. Será uma oportunidade de produzir trabalho orientado para a construção da sua carreira. Ao longo do caminho, você se unirá a colegas inspiradores e encontrará uma riqueza de clientes, culturas e experiências. Oferecemos desafios motivadores, experiências memoráveis e oportunidades para moldar seu futuro.


Inclusão e Diversidade

Estamos orgulhosos de ser diferente e isso começa com nossa gente. Acreditamos na igualdade de oportunidades para todos e não definimos as pessoas por sua raça, sexo, orientação sexual, idade ou deficiência. A individualidade é o que nos torna grandes, queremos que cada um traga seu eu completo para o trabalho e crie algo surpreendente. É com isso que nos preocupamos. Portanto, quer você se junte a nós, quer procure mudar para uma parte diferente do negócio, nós trabalhamos duro para garantir a criação de oportunidades iguais para todos.


Nossas 8 maneiras


Com mais de 48.000 especialistas dedicados em 145 mercados, nossas '8 maneiras' formam e guiam a maneira como fazemos as coisas aqui, de modo que, juntos, podemos alcançar o 'nunca antes' para nossos clientes, para a sociedade e uns para os outros.

Inspiramos mudanças.

Formamos equipes sem limites.

Todos nós lideramos.

Tornamos isso realidade.

Escalamos alto.

Escolhemos a emoção.

Somos uma força para o bem.

Somos dentsu

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Node.js/React.js)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Full Stack Engineer (Node.js/React.js) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of full stack development experience and a strong background in React.js and Node.js. You will join our clients engineering team and transform ideas and user feedback into positive experiences. You will work closely with other engineers and the user experience team iterating on designs and releasing them. Your responsibilities will include end-to-end feature development from web interfaces to backend APIs to the database. You will also communicate with the clients customers understanding their needs so you can build features with them that deliver on what you learn.

The client fosters collaboration and a close-knit working environment within its development team valuing inclusion and independent thought from its members. The client will support you as you onboard and grow within your new role, and they expect you to provide the same support to other team members. You will manage your own workload by participating in sprint planning, voicing concerns, advocating for desirable development outcomes, and proactively addressing issues. The right candidate will join a team built to produce great software!

Successful full stack engineers must have in-depth knowledge of web development concepts, a solid understanding of API and relational database design, excellent coding skills, familiarity with single page applications, and an eagerness to learn.

Our client makes trust building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The clients software platform allows companies quickly and cost effectively to adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simply to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable so businesses gain transparency into compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with User Experience and Product teams creating end-to-end, new feature designs
  • Build applications and APIs in JavaScript using React.js and Node.js
  • Develop and implement highly responsive UI components
  • Create data models using RDBMS principles, implementing them in PostgreSQL
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance
  • Communicate with and support our customers, helping them find and build solutions to their problems


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of full stack software development experience writing single-page applications that talk to API back-ends with a strong background with React.js, Node.js, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML
  • Well-developed understanding of front-end concepts and different frameworks
  • Strong back-end experience designing APIs and domain models
  • Experience working in an AWS (preferred), GCP, Azure, or other cloud environments
  • Experience designing RDBMSs to support real-world application usage
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with browser-based debugging and performance-testing software
  • A focus on customer value delivery
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what customers and team members need to achieve success
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • A willingness to learn from others and admit when you've made a mistake


Desired Experience

  • University degree in computer sciences/engineering or related field


Additional Information

  • Typical week is 40-45 hours, Monday Friday
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

  • The clients values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.
  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders proving we are dependable.
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team.
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk.
  • Evidence-Based Decisions : Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners.
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do.
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger.
  • The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people onboard from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient

We are a privately-held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Desenvolvedor de back end
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor de back end em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who We Are

DEXIAN is a global American consulting company focused on technology talent solutions to support and strengthen our clients’ IT teams. We are present in 10 countries, with 45 offices worldwide. For more than 25 years, DEXIAN® has been serving global clients across multiple industries, with the mission of attracting and retaining the world’s top talent.

Today, we are proudly recognized as one of the largest staffing augmentation companies in the United States by Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). We are also a Minority-Owned Company, and we take pride in our strong commitment to diversity.

In Brazil, we have been operating since 2007 and have successfully partnered with more than 50 clients from different sectors of the economy.


What to Expect From Us

At DEXIAN, every movement is guided by five core values: collaboration, respect, fairness, commitment, and ingenuity. These are not just concepts — they define how we work, build partnerships, and support our teams every day.

If you share these values, this is the right place for you to grow your career.

DEXIAN Brazil strongly encourages diversity, and all opportunities are open to people with disabilities and rehabilitated professionals.


About the Client

This position will support one of our clients, a global company focused in cruises.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own and implement backend services, APIs, and integrations aligned with approved Feature Design Documents
  • Write clean, maintainable, and testable code following platform standards
  • Proactively refactor code to reduce technical debt within scope
  • Act as the primary gatekeeper for backend code quality through thorough PR reviews
  • Review code for correctness, readability, performance, resource usage, and test coverage
  • Block merges that do not meet quality standards and provide actionable feedback
  • Ensure all implementations align with architectural guidelines and platform standards
  • Develop and maintain unit and integration tests, targeting 80%+ code coverage
  • Contribute to and improve overall test strategies and practices
  • Diagnose and resolve production issues, ensuring root cause resolution
  • Participate in root cause analysis and postmortems
  • Raise technical risks and architectural concerns proactively
  • Collaborate with Tech Lead to ensure alignment on implementation and design direction
  • Partner with mobile engineers on API design and integration contracts
  • Support QA teams with testability improvements and defect resolution
  • Mentor mid-level developers through code reviews and pairing sessions


Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of backend development experience
  • Strong experience with .NET / C# in production environments
  • Solid experience with RESTful API design and microservices architecture
  • Hands-on experience with trunk-based development and continuous integration
  • Strong commitment to code quality and 80%+ test coverage
  • Experience with unit testing frameworks such as xUnit, NUnit, or MSTest
  • Experience with mocking frameworks (NSubstitute preferred, Moq, FakeItEasy)
  • Familiarity with test data generation tools like AutoFixture or Bogus
  • Experience with container-based development and TestContainers
  • Experience using AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot) with governance awareness
  • Advanced English


Additional Information

• 100% Remote position - Brazil

• Long-term / indefinite project

• CLT hiring model + benefits

  • • International team environment

description:

About Headshots.com


At Headshots.com, we’re reimagining how professional headshots are created and delivered. Trusted by clients like Boeing, Capital One, and American Express, we transform smartphone selfies into polished, studio-quality portraits within three business days. Our work helps individuals and teams present themselves with consistency and confidence across digital platforms.


We’re looking for an Assistant Production Manager, reporting to the Production Manager, who will co-lead our photo editing and quality control teams, guide strategy and drive operational excellence.


About the Role


This role combines production oversight with a deep appreciation for the artistry of headshot retouching. You’ll manage the daily operations of our editing team, ensuring that each image reflects the clarity, subtlety, and professionalism our brand is known for.


We're seeking someone who brings both technical expertise and a discerning creative eye—someone who can guide a team to produce beautiful, natural edits that elevate the subject rather than over-process them.


Key Responsibilities


Production & Quality Control

  • Co-develop strategic initiatives to strengthen and improve production operations
  • Ensure timely reporting and clear communication across production workflows
  • Oversee daily editing operations to support consistent, high-quality delivery of headshots
  • Maintain quality standards across visual consistency, lighting, natural retouching, and overall image polish
  • Identify recurring issues, provide constructive feedback, and support continuous improvement across the production team
  • Step in as needed to assist with editing, troubleshooting, or complex production requests


Team Leadership & Coaching

  • Supervise and mentor a team of photo editors
  • Hire, train, and onboard new editors to uphold brand standards
  • Foster a collaborative, high-accountability culture with clear communication


Workflow Management & Operational Oversight

  • Monitor task queues and deadlines to ensure smooth project flow
  • Optimize systems and tools to eliminate inefficiencies or bottlenecks
  • Lead team meetings, track KPIs, and document standard operating procedures


Client & Project Coordination

  • Collaborate across internal teams to meet client-specific requirements
  • Maintain a client-centered approach while balancing quality and turnaround
  • Support the development of background templates, sample images, and visual assets as needed


What You Bring


Experience & Skills

  • 6+ years of photo retouching experience, especially in headshots or portraits
  • 3+ years managing creative or production teams
  • Experience with tools like Dropbox, Asana, and Slack
  • Strong organizational and communication skills


Mindset & Strengths

  • Excellent attention to detail and visual aesthetics
  • A \"no-ego\" team player: You leave your ego at the door, take extreme ownership of your work, and build deep trust through transparent communication.
  • Reliable, deadline-driven, and calm under pressure
  • Creative problem-solver with a passion for helping people look their best
  • Comfortable giving and receiving feedback in a collaborative team environment


Why Join Us?

  • Flexible, remote work
  • Work with a high-performing creative team
  • Opportunity to shape the quality and scale of a fast-growing brand


Compensation: $16-18/hour (full-time contract) depending on experience

Schedule: Monday to Friday | Flexible hours (ET hours)

Direct inquiries will disqualify candidates.

title: Desenvolvedor Python Especialista - IA Generativa
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor Python Especialista - IA Generativa em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa especialista em desenvolvimento backend com foco em Python para fortalecer plataformas e serviços críticos. A posição é estratégica e voltada à excelência técnica, com impacto direto em soluções que atendem milhões de clientes. Buscamos alguém com experiência sólida em microserviços, APIs escaláveis e aplicações robustas.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Suas atividades:

  • Desenvolver serviços backend robustos, reutilizáveis e de alta performance com Python.

  • Construir APIs RESTful com versionamento, autenticação e segurança.
  • Garantir qualidade e performance com práticas avançadas de testes e otimizações.
  • Automatizar processos de build, testes e publicação de bibliotecas internas.
  • Participar de revisões de código, definição de padrões e disseminação de boas práticas.
  • Investigar falhas e propor melhorias estruturais em produção.
  • Integrar sistemas legados e externos com boas práticas de interoperabilidade.
  • Colaborar com arquitetura, produto, QA e operações em soluções técnicas alinhadas ao negócio.


Perfil esperado:

  • Comunicação clara com perfis técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Tomada de decisão técnica com foco em simplicidade e sustentabilidade.
  • Capacidade de transformar requisitos de negócio em soluções viáveis.
  • Postura colaborativa e foco em entrega contínua.
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis.

Requisitos e qualificações


  • Proficiência em Python com Django, Flask ou FastAPI.
  • Desenvolvimento backend end-to-end em arquitetura de microserviços.
  • Controle de versão (Git), build automation e gestão de dependências (pipenv, poetry).
  • Bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL) e uso de Redis.
  • Design e versionamento de APIs REST com Swagger/OpenAPI.
  • Testes automatizados (pytest, unittest) e TDD.
  • Princípios SOLID, injeção de dependência, modularidade e padrões de projeto (Factory, Strategy etc.).
  • Arquitetura cloud-agnostic com containers (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • CI/CD e versionamento semântico.
  • Otimização de performance em aplicações Python.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em NoSQL, Elasticsearch e mecanismos de busca.
  • Clean Architecture, DDD, Hexagonal e 12-Factor App.
  • Scripts de automação (Bash/Shell) e empacotamento de bibliotecas internas.
  • Monitoramento e observabilidade (Grafana, CloudWatch, Splunk).
  • Vivência em ambientes multicloud e foco em otimização de custos.
  • Segurança de software (OWASP, OAuth 2.0, JWT) e governança técnica.
  • Uso de IA para produtividade (ex: GitHub Copilot).

title: Remote Business Analyst - 57510
description:

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


About the Role:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with digital tools, performing side-by-side evaluations, and providing clear, well-supported justifications based on fact-checking.


Responsibilities:

  • Perform side-by-side (SxS) evaluations on GHD, comparing outputs and assessing quality, accuracy, and relevance.
  • Conduct fact-checking to validate information and identify inconsistencies or inaccuracies.
  • Provide detailed, well-structured justifications to support evaluation decisions.
  • Follow established evaluation guidelines and quality standards consistently.
  • Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks.
  • Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows.
  • Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.


Requirements:

  • Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.
  • Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.
  • Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.
  • Good written communication skills in English.


Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.
  • Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments.
  • Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 30 hours per week minimum.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor/Freelancer (no medical or paid leave).
  • Time Overlap: Some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2–5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete an analytical challenge.
  • Once the assessment is cleared, you’re ready to start contributing!

title: K-POP Influencers
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para K-POP Influencers em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. K-POP & K-DRAMA Influencer Growth CreatorPowered by IZISURFAbout IZISURF

IZISURF is building a next-generation creator growth ecosystem focused on K-POP, K-Drama, Korean entertainment, and global fan communities. Our mission is to help passionate creators transform their content into scalable global media brands through audience growth, AI-powered optimization, fan engagement strategies, and cross-platform expansion.

We believe that the future of entertainment media belongs to creators who deeply understand fandom culture, digital storytelling, and internet trends. As Korean entertainment continues to influence global culture, we are creating an infrastructure that helps influencers grow faster, engage audiences more effectively, and unlock meaningful monetization opportunities.

Unlike traditional influencer agencies, IZISURF operates as a creator growth partner. We actively work alongside creators to optimize content performance, identify viral opportunities, improve audience retention, and expand creator reach across multiple social media platforms. Our goal is not only to help creators gain followers, but to help them build long-term digital brands with sustainable growth.

Position Overview

We are looking for highly creative, trend-aware, and passionate K-POP & K-Drama Influencer Growth Creators who are excited about Korean entertainment culture and want to build a strong global online presence.

This role is ideal for individuals who genuinely enjoy discussing K-POP groups, idols, dramas, entertainment news, fan theories, comeback analysis, performances, concerts, and online fandom culture. Whether you are already an influencer or an emerging creator with strong potential, we are interested in working with people who can create authentic and engaging content that resonates with audiences worldwide.

As part of IZISURF, creators will receive strategic support designed to accelerate growth. Our team helps creators improve audience engagement, optimize content formats, analyze performance metrics, and identify viral content opportunities. We work collaboratively with creators to develop sustainable content strategies rather than focusing only on short-term trends.

Responsibilities

The selected creator will regularly produce engaging content related to K-POP, K-Dramas, Korean celebrities, entertainment culture, idol trends, music releases, and fan discussions. Content may include reactions, commentary, reviews, rankings, livestream discussions, entertainment analysis, short-form videos, and community engagement activities.

Creators will publish content across platforms such as TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, YouTube, X (Twitter), Threads, and other emerging media channels. The role requires staying highly informed about ongoing entertainment trends, comeback schedules, drama releases, viral online discussions, and fandom activities.

In addition to content production, creators will collaborate closely with the IZISURF growth team to improve visibility and engagement. This includes reviewing analytics, refining content strategy, experimenting with new content formats, and participating in cross-platform growth campaigns. We encourage creators to continuously evolve their personal brand while maintaining authenticity and strong audience connection.

Creators may also participate in brand collaborations, entertainment campaigns, livestream events, fan engagement projects, and promotional activities related to Korean entertainment and digital culture.

What Makes This Opportunity Different

At IZISURF, we do not simply recruit influencers — we actively help creators grow.

Our team provides strategic support in audience development, content optimization, social media analytics, trend intelligence, and creator branding. We help creators identify what content performs best, how to improve audience retention, and how to scale engagement across multiple platforms.

Creators working with IZISURF may gain access to growth resources, collaboration opportunities, creator partnerships, AI-assisted content workflows, monetization strategies, and entertainment-related campaigns designed to increase visibility and accelerate growth.

We believe that many talented creators struggle not because of creativity, but because they lack access to proper growth infrastructure. IZISURF is designed to solve that problem by combining entertainment culture expertise with modern digital growth systems.

Preferred Qualifications

We are looking for individuals who are highly passionate about Korean entertainment culture and actively follow K-POP, K-Dramas, Korean celebrities, and fandom communities. Strong communication skills, creativity, consistency, and comfort appearing on camera are highly valuable for this role.

Experience with social media content creation is preferred, but we are also open to emerging creators who demonstrate strong potential, personality, and storytelling ability. Familiarity with short-form video platforms, editing tools, and internet culture trends is important.

Candidates who already maintain active social media accounts, fan communities, or entertainment-focused content channels are strongly encouraged to apply. Korean language skills are a plus but are not required.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who genuinely enjoys talking about Korean entertainment and naturally engages with online communities. You are someone who understands internet culture, stays updated on trends, and enjoys creating content that sparks discussion and engagement.

You are creative, ambitious, and interested in building a long-term digital presence rather than simply posting occasional entertainment updates. You are excited about growing alongside a team that actively supports creator development and digital brand expansion.

Most importantly, you understand fandom culture and can create content that feels authentic, relatable, and engaging to global audiences.

title: Headshots Retoucher
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Headshots Retoucher em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job description:

About Us

Headshots.com is transforming how professional headshots are delivered. Trusted by enterprise clients such as Boeing, Netflix, and American Express, we produce studio-quality headshots from smartphone images—backed by world-class production and technology.

Our retouching team is critical to delivering consistent, natural, high-quality results at scale. We are hiring experienced headshot retouchers for ongoing work who can handle high volume while maintaining realism, accuracy, and professional polish.


Role Overview

This role focuses on high-quality retouching of professional headshots sourced from mobile phone photos. You will work within established production standards to deliver natural, realistic results—preserving skin texture, correcting lighting issues, and ensuring consistency across batches.

Following a brief unpaid test project, selected candidates will invited for an interview, with the opportunity for long-term, steady work.


Core Responsibilities

Image Retouching & Quality Control

  • Retouch professional headshots from phone photos with a natural, realistic finish
  • Correct skin tone, noise, mixed lighting, exposure issues, and soft focus
  • Reduce or remove glasses glare while preserving realism
  • Perform background swaps and composites that look seamless and believable
  • Maintain consistency and quality across large batches of images


Production & Workflow Discipline

  • Deliver work on time and meet daily/weekly volume expectations
  • Follow established retouching guidelines and quality standards
  • Apply feedback consistently and efficiently
  • Communicate clearly if issues arise that could affect timelines or quality


Core Skills Required

  • Natural skin retouching (texture preserved; no plastic or over-processed look)
  • Clean hair masking and edge work (no halos)
  • Realistic background compositing
  • Strong color correction and exposure balancing, especially in uneven or mixed light
  • Excellent time management and consistency at scale
  • Strong written English (spoken English for occasional Zoom calls is a plus)


Hardware & Software Requirements (Must-Have)

  • Graphics tablet (Wacom, Huion, XP-Pen, or similar)
  • Legitimate Adobe Photoshop subscription (no cracked software)
  • MacBook Pro Retina or equivalent high-quality PC laptop display
  • Monitor accurate in sRGB (DCI-P3 support is a plus)


Volume, Timing & Pay

  • $5 USD per image
  • Expected volume after trial period: 100+ images/month, with potential to scale higher
  • The $2,000/month reference rate is based on completing approximately 20 headshots per day across 20 working days


Application Requirements (Read Carefully)

Apply by completing the test project:


Hiring Process

  • Applicants are asked to complete a brief unpaid test project
  • Successful test submissions will be invited to interview
  • Ongoing, consistent work available for high-performing retouchers
  • Direct inquiries will disqualify candidates. All applications must be submitted through Indeed.
  • Job Types: Full-time, Contract


IMPORTANT

All candidates must apply via LinkedIn. Direct contact with Headshots.com regarding this position will not be considered and may result in disqualification from the process.

title: Contract Review Attorney
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Contract Review Attorney em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Headshots.com 

At Headshots.com, we're reimagining how professional headshots are created and delivered. Trusted by clients like Boeing, Capital One, and American Express, we transform smartphone selfies into polished, studio-quality portraits within three business days. As our enterprise client base expands across industries and geographies, including a growing footprint in regulated healthcare environments, we are building out our legal function to support that growth.


We're looking for a Contract Review Attorney, reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, who will own the day-to-day review and negotiation of commercial agreements, partner closely with our business teams, and help us scale a thoughtful, risk-calibrated approach to enterprise contracting.


About the Role 

This role combines hands-on contract review with a strategic understanding of how commercial terms translate into operational risk and opportunity. You will be the primary reviewer on incoming Master Services Agreements, Business Associate Agreements, Data Processing Addenda, Statements of Work, and vendor contracts. You will work directly with leadership to redline, negotiate, and finalize agreements that protect the company while preserving the speed and flexibility that allow us to serve enterprise clients well.


We are looking for someone who brings both technical legal expertise and strong commercial judgment, someone who can identify which provisions matter, where to push, and where to accept reasonable client positions in service of getting deals closed.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the review and redlining of MSAs, BAAs, DPAs, SOWs, NDAs, and vendor agreements. Identify risk, draft fallback positions, and negotiate directly with client legal teams when needed. Translate complex legal terms into clear, plain-language recommendations for the business.
  • Coordinate with the business on Standard Contractual Clauses, data transfer impact assessments, and DPA terms.
  • Negotiate indemnification, limitation of liability, insurance requirements, IP ownership, audit rights, termination, and assignment provisions in a way that is proportionate to our scope and revenue. 
  • Develop playbooks and fallback positions so the business can move quickly on standard issues. Maintain contract templates, position playbooks, and a clause library. 
  • Work directly with sales, operations, and leadership to support active deal cycles. Translate legal positions into commercial recommendations. Provide guidance during pre-contract discussions so issues are surfaced early.
  • Track the status of in-flight negotiations and ensure timely follow-up with client counterparties.


What You Bring

Experience & Qualifications

  • Law degree (JD or LLM) from an accredited institution
  • Six or more years of commercial contracts experience, with meaningful time spent in-house or supporting in-house teams.
  • 5+ years of demonstrated experience reviewing and negotiating agreements (US and European commercial clients a plus)
  • Working knowledge of GDPR and cross-border data transfer requirements.
  • Strong command of commercial provisions: indemnification, limitation of liability, IP ownership, insurance, confidentiality, data security, termination, and assignment.
  • Familiarity with SaaS, professional services, and vendor agreements. 
  • Excellent English skills, both written and spoken. 


Mindset & Strengths

  • Commercial pragmatism. You understand that legal review serves business outcomes, and you know when to push, when to compromise, and when to escalate.
  • Clear written communication. You can explain complex legal positions to non-lawyers in plain language and translate client redlines into clear recommendations.
  • Calm and thorough under deadline pressure. You can manage multiple active negotiations without losing track of detail.
  • Independent operator. You can run a contract review process end-to-end with limited supervision and know when to surface issues to leadership.
  • Discretion and trustworthiness. You handle confidential business information with care.
  • A no-ego collaborator. You build trust through transparent communication, take ownership of your work, and welcome feedback.


Why Join Us 

Fully remote, flexible schedule with ET overlap. Work directly with founders and executive leadership on agreements that shape the company's growth. Opportunity to build out the legal function and contracting infrastructure at a fast-moving company. Exposure to a diverse, enterprise client base across industries and geographies.


IMPORTANT

Direct inquiries will disqualify candidates.


Compensation: $40-60/hour depending on experience

description:

Title: Senior Specialist, Global ICSR Case Processing & QC

Department: Global Patient Safety


Overview:

Seeking an experienced Senior Specialist in Global ICSR Case Processing & QC to independently manage the processing and quality control of individual case safety reports (ICSRs), ensuring regulatory compliance and excellence in data accuracy, completeness, and quality. The role includes SAE reconciliation, meeting compliance and productivity targets, and supporting onboarding and training for new team members.


Key Responsibilities:

  • ICSR Case Processing: Manage case processing and quality control of ICSRs from diverse sources (e.g., clinical trials, post-market, literature) to ensure timely, accurate submissions to regulatory authorities.
  • SAE Reconciliation: Perform SAE reconciliations between safety and clinical databases, track progress, resolve issues, and escalate when necessary.
  • Quality & Compliance: Adhere to KPI and quality metrics, ensuring productivity and process improvement within ICSR management.
  • Decision-Making: Execute decisions in line with operational policies, SOPs, and work instructions.
  • Vendor/CRO Coordination: Ensure ICSR activities align with PV agreements and contracts.
  • Training & Onboarding: Develop and update training materials, onboard new team members, provide feedback, and support the onboarding process.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, clinical medicine, nursing, pharmacy, or equivalent experience; advanced degree preferred.
  • Proficiency with Argus safety database and MS Office Suite.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in drug safety/pharmacovigilance or relevant clinical experience. Preferred 5-8 years of experience
  • Strong understanding of global regulatory requirements (e.g., ICH, FDA, EMA, MHRA) for pharmacovigilance reporting.
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, time management, and attention to detail.
  • Global cultural awareness and collaborative mindset.
